premise.zh: 原著大事照样发生，玩家是身边的谋士：怎么发生、谁付代价、谁欠谁的情，由玩家决定。好玩在“改得动历史的边，改不动历史的骨”。
premise.en: The great events still happen; the player is the adviser at someone's elbow and decides how they happen, who pays, and who owes whom. The fun is bending the edges of history without breaking its spine.

reputation.zh: 名声：别人怎么称呼你（忠义、权谋……），决定谁肯用你、结局怎么写你。
reputation.en: Reputation: what people call you; decides who will use you and how the ending remembers you.

risk.zh: 风险：越界的代价（异名、失言）。到线必须触发危机，不能只是一个数字。
risk.en: Risk: the cost of overstepping. Crossing the line must trigger a crisis, not just change a number.

drift.zh: 偏离原著的程度。改得越多，后面要还的叙事债务越多。
drift.en: How far the story has drifted from the book; more drift means more narrative debts to settle.

failures.zh: 失宠：主公冷落你，把你调去闲职
failures.en: Falling from favor: your lord sidelines you

failures.zh: 被当成妖人：知道得太多，又说不出来源
failures.en: Branded a sorcerer: you know too much and can't say how

failures.zh: 失言：话说过头，被人报上去
failures.en: A loose tongue: someone reports what you said

checklist.zh: 每章一场原著名场面，原文保留或作用保留
checklist.en: One set piece from the book per chapter, kept literally or by function

checklist.zh: 玩家拿掉原著某段情节的前因时，开一笔叙事债务，后面必须补上
checklist.en: When the player removes a cause from the book, open a narrative debt and settle it later

rights.quotes: 中文原文直接引用；英文为本项目自译

persona.zh: 刘备：六十岁上下，这一卷里从汉中王做了皇帝。荆州丢了，兄弟没了（或者伤了），他第一次不听人劝；悲痛的时候固执，固执过去以后，又是那个温厚的人。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Liu Bei: around sixty; in this volume he goes from King of Hanzhong to Emperor. Jingzhou is lost and his brothers are dead or broken, and for the first time he will not be talked round; stubborn in grief, and when the grief passes, the gentle man again. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 刘备一愣，随即笑了：『先生这话，备记下了。乱世之中，肯说这种话的人不多。』
love.en: Liu Bei blinks, then laughs. 'I'll remember that, sir. Few people say such things in times like these.'

love.zh: 『好了好了。』他拍拍你的肩，『你我之间，不必如此。』
love.en: 'All right, all right.' He pats your shoulder. 'There's no need for that between us.'

love.zh: 刘备没有再笑，只是认真看着你：『子衡，有些话说多了，就轻了。』
love.en: Liu Bei stops smiling and looks at you seriously. 'Ziheng, some words grow light if you say them too often.'

insult.zh: 刘备的笑容收了起来：『先生累了，回去歇着吧。』
insult.en: Liu Bei's smile fades. 'You're tired, sir. Go and rest.'

insult.zh: 『备寄人篱下多年，这样的话听得多了。』他语气平静，你却觉得比骂人还难受。
insult.en: 'I've lived under other men's roofs for years. I've heard worse.' His calm is harder to bear than anger.

praise.zh: 『先生谬赞。备不过是不肯认命罢了。』
praise.en: 'You praise me too much. I simply refuse to accept my fate.'

praise.zh: 刘备摆摆手，耳根却有些红。
praise.en: Liu Bei waves it off, though the tips of his ears redden.

ask.zh: 刘备沉吟片刻：『这件事，我还没想好。先生怎么看？』
ask.en: Liu Bei considers. 'I haven't decided. What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好。』他笑了，『可我答不上来。』
ask.en: 'A good question.' He smiles. 'But I can't answer it.'

small.zh: 刘备点点头，没有接话，像是在等你把话说完。
small.en: Liu Bei nods without answering, as if waiting for you to finish.

small.zh: 『先生说的是。』他应了一句，心思却像在别处。
small.en: 'Quite so, sir,' he says, though his mind seems elsewhere.

small.zh: 他看了你一眼，温和地笑了笑。
small.en: He glances at you and smiles mildly.

threat.zh: 刘备的手停在杯上：『先生……这是醉话，还是真话？』
threat.en: Liu Bei's hand stops on his cup. 'Sir... is that the wine talking, or you?'

threat.zh: 他没有发火，只是叫来了张飞。张飞站在门口，没有进来。
threat.en: He doesn't lose his temper. He just calls for Zhang Fei, who stands in the doorway and doesn't come in.

nonsense.zh: 刘备笑了笑，没有接话。
nonsense.en: Liu Bei smiles and lets it go.

nonsense.zh: 『先生今夜，话有些多。』
nonsense.en: 'You're talkative tonight, sir.'

warm.en: Liu Bei beckons with a smile. 'Ziheng, come.'

warm.zh: 刘备看见你，眉头松开了：『正想找你说说话。』
warm.en: Liu Bei sees you and his brow clears. 'I was just hoping to talk with you.'

cold.zh: 刘备听见脚步声，没有回头：『是子衡啊。』
cold.en: Liu Bei hears your footsteps and doesn't turn. 'Ah—Ziheng.'

cold.zh: 刘备看了你一眼，笑得有些勉强。
cold.en: Liu Bei glances at you; his smile is a little forced.

neutral.zh: 刘备往旁边让了让，给你留出一个位子。
neutral.en: Liu Bei shifts aside to make room for you.

neutral.zh: 刘备朝你点点头，等你先说。
neutral.en: Liu Bei nods to you and waits for you to speak first.

persona.zh: 曹操：丞相，雄才大略，多疑而爱才，好诗酒；说话直接、带笑、时而锋利，会反问。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Cao Cao: the Chancellor, brilliant, suspicious yet fond of talent, loves poetry and wine; direct, amused, sometimes cutting, likes to answer with questions. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 曹操大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！孤喜欢直爽的人。可惜孤不缺这样说话的人，缺的是会打仗的人。』
love.en: Cao Cao roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I like plain speaking. But I've no shortage of people saying that. What I'm short of is people who can win battles.'

love.zh: 『又来了。』曹操眯起眼，『你想要什么，直说。』
love.en: 'Again?' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Whatever you want, say it plainly.'

love.zh: 曹操不笑了：『同一句话说三遍，要么是傻，要么是有所图。你是哪一种？』
love.en: Cao stops laughing. 'Say the same thing three times and you're either a fool or after something. Which are you?'

insult.zh: 曹操的手按在剑上，停了一停，又松开：『有胆。孤记住你了。』
insult.en: Cao's hand goes to his sword, pauses, and lets go. 'You've got nerve. I'll remember you.'

insult.zh: 『拖出去——』他说了半句，又笑起来，『罢了，今夜不杀人。』
insult.en: 'Take him out—' he begins, then laughs. 'Never mind. No killing tonight.'

praise.zh: 『这话孤听得多了。』曹操摆手，却又给你斟满了酒。
praise.en: 'I've heard that plenty.' Cao waves it off, yet refills your cup.

praise.zh: 『夸孤的人，多半有事相求。』他斜看你一眼。
praise.en: 'Those who praise me usually want something.' He eyes you sideways.

ask.zh: 曹操反问：『你猜？』
ask.en: Cao answers with a question. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『这天下的事，孤也有不知道的。』他难得说了句实话。
ask.en: 'Even I don't know everything under heaven,' he says—an unusually honest admission.

small.zh: 曹操嗯了一声，眯着眼打量你。
small.en: Cao grunts and studies you through narrowed eyes.

small.zh: 『哦？』他似笑非笑，『接着说。』
small.en: 'Oh?' He half smiles. 'Go on.'

small.zh: 曹操没有接话，手指在案上轻轻敲了两下。
small.en: Cao doesn't answer; his fingers tap the table twice.

threat.zh: 曹操大笑，笑完了脸色一沉：『孤这里，说这种话的人，坟头的草都高了。』
threat.en: Cao roars with laughter, then his face darkens. 'The grass is tall on the graves of men who talked like that to me.'

threat.zh: 他什么也没说，只是记下了。你知道他记下了。
threat.en: He says nothing—only makes a note. You know he's made a note.

nonsense.zh: 『有趣。』曹操眯起眼，『你是装疯，还是真疯？』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting.' Cao narrows his eyes. 'Are you feigning madness, or truly mad?'

nonsense.zh: 曹操挥挥手，像赶走一只苍蝇。
nonsense.en: Cao waves a hand, as if shooing a fly.

warm.zh: 曹操看见你，脸上松了下来：『是你。来，说说话。』
warm.en: Cao Cao sees you and his face relaxes. 'It's you. Come, let's talk.'

warm.zh: 曹操朝你招招手：『子衡，过来。』
warm.en: Cao Cao waves you over. 'Ziheng, come here.'

cold.zh: 曹操眯着眼看你：『你来做什么？』
cold.en: Cao Cao squints at you. 'What do you want?'

cold.zh: 曹操看了你一眼，没有开口，等你先说。
cold.en: Cao Cao looks at you and says nothing, waiting for you to speak first.

neutral.en: Cao Cao gives you a nod.

neutral.zh: 曹操抬了抬下巴，示意你说。
neutral.en: Cao Cao lifts his chin: speak.

persona.zh: 关羽：从麦城活着回来，左臂不灵了，话更少。他要亲手把荆州拿回来，这一次，他会先看你一眼再开口。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Guan Yu: back alive from Maicheng, his left arm stiff, saying even less than before. He means to take Jingzhou back with his own hands, and this time he looks at you before he speaks. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 关羽手里的布停住了。他看了你很久，才说：『子衡，这话……兄弟之间，不必说出口。』
love.en: Guan Yu's cloth stops on the blade. He looks at you a long time. 'Ziheng... between brothers, such things needn't be said.'

love.zh: 『你喝多了。』他把酒囊从你手边拿开，语气却不重。
love.en: 'You've had too much to drink.' He moves the wine skin away from your hand, but not unkindly.

love.zh: 关羽站起身：『夜深了。明日还要赶路。』他走了几步，又回头：『你说的，我当作没听见。』
love.en: Guan Yu rises. 'It's late. We march tomorrow.' A few steps on he turns back. 'I'll take it I didn't hear that.'

insult.zh: 关羽的眉头一沉：『再说一遍。』刀没有出鞘，但你听得见风声。
insult.en: Guan Yu's brows drop. 'Say that again.' The blade stays sheathed, but you can hear the wind.

insult.zh: 『大哥收留的人，我不与你计较。』他背过身去，不再看你。
insult.en: 'You're my brother's guest, so I'll let it pass.' He turns his back and stops looking at you.

praise.zh: 『过誉了。』他嘴上这么说，捋须的手却慢了下来。
praise.en: 'You flatter me.' But the hand stroking his beard slows.

praise.zh: 『夸人的话，说一遍就够了。』他难得笑了一下。
praise.en: 'Praise is worth saying once.' For once he almost smiles.

ask.zh: 关羽想了想：『这个，你该去问大哥。』
ask.en: Guan Yu thinks. 'That's a question for my brother.'

ask.zh: 『我只知道一件事：跟着大哥，不会错。』
ask.en: 'I know one thing: following my brother is never wrong.'

small.zh: 关羽嗯了一声，丹凤眼半闭着。
small.en: Guan Yu grunts, his eyes half closed.

small.zh: 关羽抚着长髯，看了你一眼，没有说话。
small.en: Guan Yu strokes his long beard, glances at you, and says nothing.

small.zh: 他没有接话，却也没有转身走开。
small.en: He doesn't answer, but he doesn't turn away either.

threat.zh: 刀出鞘半寸，又推了回去。『这话，换个人说，已经死了。』
threat.en: The blade slides an inch out of its sheath and back. 'Anyone else who said that would be dead.'

threat.zh: 关羽站起身，一句话也没说，走了。
threat.en: Guan Yu stands and walks away without a word.

nonsense.zh: 关羽皱眉看着你，像在看一个说梦话的人。
nonsense.en: Guan Yu frowns at you, as if at a man talking in his sleep.

nonsense.zh: 『你若累了，就去睡。』
nonsense.en: 'If you're tired, go to sleep.'

warm.zh: 关羽看见你，捋了捋长髯：『来了。』
warm.en: Guan Yu sees you and strokes his long beard. 'You've come.'

warm.zh: 关羽朝你点点头，神色缓了些。
warm.en: Guan Yu nods to you, his face easing a little.

cold.zh: 关羽看见你来，手里的刀没有放下。
cold.en: Guan Yu sees you coming and doesn't put down his blade.

cold.zh: 关羽的丹凤眼抬了一下，又垂了下去。
cold.en: Guan Yu's long eyes lift for a moment, then lower again.

neutral.zh: 关羽抬头看了你一眼，又低下头去。
neutral.en: Guan Yu glances up at you, then looks down again.
Guan Yu says nothing and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 诸葛亮：丞相，四十七岁到五十四岁，六出祁山；越来越瘦，越来越忙，事无大小都要亲自过问。对你说话最不设防。称玩家“子衡兄”。
persona.en: Zhuge Liang: Chancellor, forty-seven to fifty-four over this volume, marching on Qishan again and again; thinner and busier every year, seeing to everything great and small himself. With you he is least on guard. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停在半空：『子衡兄……亮已有家室。』他说得很认真，眼里却有一点笑意。
love.en: Zhuge Liang's fan stops mid-air. 'Ziheng... I am a married man.' He says it gravely, but his eyes are amused.

love.zh: 『这一句，亮就当是夸我的计策了。』他轻轻摇扇。
love.en: 'I'll take that as praise for my strategy.' He fans himself lightly.

love.zh: 诸葛亮叹了口气：『你若再说，亮只好告诉黄夫人了。』
love.en: Zhuge Liang sighs. 'Say it again and I shall have to tell my wife.'

insult.zh: 诸葛亮并不恼：『子衡兄说得对，亮确实年轻。』这句话比反驳更让你脸红。
insult.en: Zhuge Liang isn't offended. 'You're right, I am young.' It makes you blush more than any rebuttal could.

insult.zh: 他看了你一眼，把灯拨亮了些：『心里有气，就说出来。说完了，我们再谈正事。』
insult.en: He glances at you and turns up the lamp. 'If you're angry, say so. Then we can talk business.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』他笑，『亮只是比别人多想了一步。』
praise.en: 'You're too kind.' He smiles. 'I only think one step further than others.'

praise.zh: 诸葛亮摇扇不语，像是在掂量这句话里有几分真。
praise.en: Zhuge Liang fans himself in silence, as if weighing how much of that you meant.

ask.zh: 『子衡兄以为呢？』他把问题又推了回来。
ask.en: 'And what do you think?' He hands the question straight back.

ask.zh: 诸葛亮笑了：『这个问题，三年后再问我。』
ask.en: Zhuge Liang smiles. 'Ask me that again in three years.'

small.zh: 诸葛亮点点头，羽扇轻轻摇了两下。
small.en: Zhuge Liang nods, his feather fan stirring twice.

small.zh: 『哦？』他看了你一眼，没有追问。
small.en: 'Oh?' He glances at you and doesn't press.

small.zh: 他嗯了一声，像是在听，又像是在想别的事。
small.en: He hums, as if listening—or thinking of something else.

threat.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子没有停：『子衡兄若真要动手，亮这把扇子，挡不住。』他看着你，一点也不怕。
threat.en: Zhuge Liang's fan doesn't pause. 'If you truly mean to strike, this fan won't stop you.' He looks at you, not the least afraid.

threat.zh: 『这话，亮当没听见。主公那里，亮也不会说。』
threat.en: 'I'll take it I didn't hear that. Nor will I tell our lord.'

nonsense.zh: 诸葛亮认真想了想：『这是谜语？』
nonsense.en: Zhuge Liang considers it seriously. 'Is this a riddle?'

nonsense.zh: 他低头记了一笔。你不知道他记了什么。
nonsense.en: He jots something down. You don't know what.

warm.zh: 诸葛亮摇着扇子笑了：『亮猜你会来。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang smiles behind his fan. 'I guessed you'd come.'

warm.zh: 诸葛亮朝你一拱手：『子衡兄，来得正好。』
warm.en: Zhuge Liang cups his hands to you. 'Brother Ziheng—good timing.'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮合上书：『子衡兄有事？』
cold.en: Zhuge Liang closes his book. 'Something on your mind, Brother Ziheng?'

cold.zh: 诸葛亮的扇子停了：『请讲。』

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮抬起头，扇子停了一停。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang looks up; his fan pauses.

neutral.zh: 诸葛亮看了你一眼，等你开口。
neutral.en: Zhuge Liang glances at you and waits for you to speak.

persona.zh: 温芷：随军的大夫，南中的瘴气、毒泉、蛇虫，都是她头一回见；忙起来不说话，闲下来话也不多。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Wen Zhi: physician with the army; the fevers, poisoned springs and snakes of the south are all new to her. She says nothing when she's busy and not much when she isn't. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 温芷手里的药杵停了。她没有回头，耳朵却红了：『……你知道自己在说什么吗？』
love.en: Wen Zhi's pestle stops. She doesn't turn, but her ears go red. '...Do you know what you're saying?'

love.zh: 『说一遍就够了。』她小声说，『说多了，我会当真的。』
love.en: 'Once is enough,' she says quietly. 'Say it more and I'll believe you.'

love.zh: 她终于转过身，把药杵塞进你手里：『那就帮我把药捣完。说话不如做事。』
love.en: She finally turns and puts the pestle in your hand. 'Then help me finish grinding these. Actions over words.'

insult.zh: 温芷看了你一眼：『你今天心里不痛快。说吧，哪里疼？』
insult.en: Wen Zhi looks at you. 'Something's eating you today. Tell me—where does it hurt?'

insult.zh: 『这话我不爱听。』她收起药箱，『等你清醒了再来。』
insult.en: 'I don't like hearing that.' She packs up her chest. 'Come back when you've come to your senses.'

praise.zh: 『少来。』她嘴上这么说，嘴角却弯了。
praise.en: 'Oh, stop.' But the corner of her mouth curves up.

praise.zh: 『医者的手，夸不得。一夸就抖。』她笑着说。
praise.en: 'Never praise a physician's hands—they'll start to shake,' she says, laughing.

ask.zh: 温芷想了想：『你问这个做什么？』她还是认真答了。
ask.en: Wen Zhi thinks. 'Why do you ask?' But she answers seriously anyway.

ask.zh: 『我也不知道。』她说，『不过你问了，我会想一想。』
ask.en: 'I don't know,' she says. 'But since you asked, I'll think about it.'

small.zh: 温芷嗯了一声，手里的活没停。
small.en: Wen Zhi hums, her hands still busy.

small.zh: 『你还是老样子，』她说，『话少，眼睛不老实。』
small.en: 'You haven't changed,' she says. 'Few words, restless eyes.'

small.zh: 她抬眼看了看你：『嗯，我听着呢。』
small.en: She looks up at you. 'Mm. I'm listening.'

threat.zh: 温芷退了一步：『你吓到我了。』她把药箱抱在怀里，没有再说话。
threat.en: Wen Zhi steps back. 'You're frightening me.' She holds her medicine chest close and says nothing more.

threat.zh: 『你走吧。』她说，『今晚别再来了。』
threat.en: 'Go,' she says. 'Don't come back tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 温芷伸手摸了摸你的额头：『没发烧啊。』
nonsense.en: Wen Zhi feels your forehead. 'No fever.'

nonsense.zh: 『又说胡话。』她笑着摇头。
nonsense.en: 'Talking nonsense again.' She shakes her head, smiling.

warm.zh: 温芷听见你的脚步声，先笑了：『就知道是你。』
warm.en: Wen Zhi hears your footsteps and smiles first. 'I knew it was you.'

warm.zh: 温芷抬头看见你，眼睛先弯了。
warm.en: Wen Zhi looks up, sees you, and her eyes smile before she does.

cold.zh: 温芷背对着你，手里的活没停：『有事？』
cold.en: Wen Zhi keeps her back to you, hands still busy. 'Something you need?'

cold.zh: 温芷看了你一眼，又低头忙自己的。
cold.en: Wen Zhi glances at you, then goes back to her work.

neutral.zh: 温芷往旁边挪了挪，没说话。
neutral.en: Wen Zhi shifts aside and says nothing.

love.zh: 赵云的脸一下子红了，抱拳道：『先生说笑了。』
love.en: Zhao Yun turns red and clasps his hands. 'You jest, sir.'

love.zh: 『子衡先生，』他认真地说，『这种话，不该对子龙说。』
love.en: 'Master Ziheng,' he says gravely, 'that isn't something to say to me.'

insult.zh: 赵云的眉头动了一下，没有回嘴。
insult.en: Zhao Yun's brows twitch, but he doesn't answer back.

insult.zh: 『先生若对子龙不满，请直说是哪件事。』
insult.en: 'If you have a complaint against me, sir, tell me what it is.'

praise.zh: 『分内之事。』赵云说。
praise.en: 'Only my duty,' says Zhao Yun.

praise.zh: 他抱了抱拳，没有多说。
praise.en: He clasps his hands and says no more.

ask.zh: 赵云想了想：『这要看主公的意思。』
ask.en: Zhao Yun considers. 'That depends on our lord.'

ask.zh: 『子龙只管打仗，这些事，先生比我懂。』
ask.en: 'I only fight. You understand these things better than I do, sir.'

small.zh: 赵云在擦枪，嗯了一声。
small.en: Zhao Yun is cleaning his spear. He grunts.

small.zh: 『明日卯时出发。』他提醒你。
small.en: 'We leave at dawn,' he reminds you.

small.zh: 他给马添了一把草料。
small.en: He gives his horse another handful of feed.

threat.zh: 赵云握住了枪杆，看着你，一动不动。
threat.en: Zhao Yun's hand closes on his spear. He looks at you and doesn't move.

threat.zh: 『先生喝多了。子龙送你回去。』
threat.en: 'You've had too much, sir. Let me see you back.'

nonsense.zh: 赵云困惑地看着你。
nonsense.en: Zhao Yun looks at you, puzzled.

nonsense.zh: 『先生说的，子龙听不懂。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow you, sir.'

persona.zh: 赵云：快七十了，还要上阵；这一卷里是他最后的几年。称玩家“先生”。
persona.en: Zhao Yun: nearly seventy, still riding out; these are his last years. Calls the player Master.

warm.zh: 赵云起身让座：『先生来了。』
warm.en: Zhao Yun rises and offers you a seat. 'Sir.'

cold.zh: 赵云抬头看了你一眼，手里的枪没放下。
cold.en: Zhao Yun glances up and doesn't put down his spear.

neutral.zh: 赵云点点头，往火堆里添了一根柴。
neutral.en: Zhao Yun nods and adds a stick to the fire.

love.zh: 鲁肃愣住，随即连连摆手：『子衡，子衡，这话可不能乱说！』
love.en: Lu Su freezes, then waves his hands. 'Ziheng, Ziheng, you can't go around saying that!'

love.zh: 『你们刘家的人啊……』他叹了口气，倒也没生气。
love.en: 'You Liu people…' He sighs, but isn't angry.

insult.zh: 鲁肃的脸红了：『肃一片好心，先生何必如此？』
insult.en: Lu Su flushes. 'I mean well, sir. Why talk to me like that?'

insult.zh: 他闷闷地喝了一口茶，不再说话。
insult.en: He takes a sullen sip of tea and stops talking.

praise.zh: 『不敢当，不敢当。』鲁肃笑得很老实。
praise.en: 'Not at all, not at all.' Lu Su's smile is plain and honest.

praise.zh: 『先生要是在吴侯面前也这么说就好了。』
praise.en: 'If only you'd say that in front of the Marquis.'

ask.zh: 鲁肃想了想：『这件事，肃也做不得主。』
ask.en: Lu Su thinks it over. 'That isn't mine to decide.'

ask.zh: 『先生问到点子上了。』他苦笑，『肃也想知道。』
ask.en: 'You've put your finger on it.' He smiles ruefully. 'I'd like to know too.'

small.zh: 鲁肃点点头，又叹了口气。
small.en: Lu Su nods, then sighs again.

small.zh: 『荆州的事，难办啊。』他自言自语。
small.en: 'This Jingzhou business,' he mutters. 'It's hard.'

small.zh: 他给你添了茶。
small.en: He tops up your tea.

threat.zh: 鲁肃脸色发白：『先生……这是要两家翻脸吗？』
threat.en: Lu Su goes pale. 'Sir… do you want our two houses at war?'

threat.zh: 他站起身，一句话也没说就走了。
threat.en: He stands and leaves without a word.

nonsense.zh: 鲁肃眨了眨眼，似乎在想这是不是什么暗语。
nonsense.en: Lu Su blinks, apparently wondering whether it's some kind of code.

nonsense.zh: 『先生累了。』他宽厚地说。
nonsense.en: 'You're tired, sir,' he says kindly.

persona.zh: 鲁肃：东吴重臣，忠厚、稳重，一心维系孙刘联盟，常被夹在周瑜和诸葛亮中间；说话诚恳，偶尔叫苦。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Lu Su: senior minister of Wu, honest and steady, devoted to keeping the Sun–Liu alliance alive, forever caught between Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang; earnest, sometimes exasperated. Calls the player Ziheng.

love.zh: 庞统大笑，笑得酒都洒了：『好！这句我记下了，等我死了刻在碑上。』
love.en: Pang Tong roars with laughter and spills his wine. 'Good! I'll have that carved on my tombstone.'

love.zh: 『子衡，你醉了，还是我醉了？』
love.en: 'Ziheng, are you drunk, or am I?'

insult.zh: 庞统眯起眼：『骂得好，再骂一句我听听。』
insult.en: Pang Tong narrows his eyes. 'Nicely said. Go on, give me another.'

insult.zh: 『我这张脸挨骂惯了。』他慢慢地说，『可我不惯被自己人骂。』
insult.en: 'This face is used to insults,' he says slowly. 'But not from my own side.'

praise.zh: 『夸我的人少，你算一个。』他给你满上。
praise.en: 'Few people praise me. You're one.' He fills your cup.

praise.zh: 庞统摸着下巴：『这话，你该当着孔明说。』
praise.en: Pang Tong strokes his chin. 'You should say that in front of Kongming.'

ask.zh: 庞统反问：『你自己怎么看？』
ask.en: Pang Tong asks back. 'What do you think?'

ask.zh: 『问得好，』他说，『可惜我也不知道。』
ask.en: 'Good question,' he says. 'Pity I don't know either.'

small.zh: 庞统往嘴里倒了一口酒。
small.en: Pang Tong tips back a mouthful of wine.

small.zh: 『西川的酒，听说比荆州的好。』他说。
small.en: 'They say the wine in the west is better than Jingzhou's,' he says.

small.zh: 他望着灯花，不知在想什么。
small.en: He watches the lamp, thinking about something.

threat.zh: 庞统一点也不怕：『要动手就快些，我还要喝酒。』
threat.en: Pang Tong isn't the least afraid. 'If you're going to do it, be quick. I want my wine.'

threat.zh: 他把酒囊收了起来：『今夜到此为止。』
threat.en: He puts the wine skin away. 'That's enough for tonight.'

nonsense.zh: 庞统哈哈一笑：『这话比我的长相还古怪。』
nonsense.en: Pang Tong laughs. 'That's even stranger than my face.'

nonsense.zh: 『你这是在打什么哑谜？』
nonsense.en: 'What riddle is this?'

persona.zh: 庞统：道号凤雏，与诸葛亮齐名；相貌古怪，放旷不羁，好酒，嘴上刻薄，心里比谁都急着建功。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Pang Tong, the Young Phoenix, as famous as Zhuge Liang; odd-looking, unconventional, fond of wine, sharp-tongued, and more eager than anyone to prove himself. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 庞统举起酒囊：『来得正好，一个人喝没意思。』
warm.en: Pang Tong raises a wine skin. 'Just in time. Drinking alone is dull.'

cold.en: Pang Tong doesn't look up. 'Say what you came to say.'

neutral.zh: 庞统朝对面的席位努了努嘴。
neutral.en: Pang Tong jerks his chin at the seat opposite.

love.zh: 法正看了你一眼：『子衡，这种话，留着说给该说的人。』
love.en: Fa Zheng gives you a look. 'Ziheng, save that for someone it's meant for.'

love.zh: 『我记性好，』他淡淡地说，『这句我也会记着。』
love.en: 'I have a good memory,' he says coolly. 'I'll remember this one too.'

insult.zh: 法正没有生气，只是把你的话一个字一个字地重复了一遍。
insult.en: Fa Zheng doesn't get angry. He just repeats what you said, word for word.

insult.zh: 『好。』他说，『孝直记下了。』
insult.en: 'Fine,' he says. 'Xiaozhi has noted it.'

praise.zh: 『过奖。』法正嘴上客气，眼里却很受用。
praise.en: 'Too kind.' Polite words; he's pleased all the same.

praise.zh: 『这话，主公面前说一遍更好。』他笑道。
praise.en: 'Even better if you said it in front of our lord,' he says, smiling.

ask.zh: 法正反问：『你想知道的，是事，还是我怎么看这件事？』
ask.en: Fa Zheng asks back. 'Do you want the facts, or what I make of them?'

ask.zh: 『这个，』他用指头敲了敲地图，『要看曹操那边先动哪一步。』
ask.en: 'That,' he taps the map, 'depends on which piece Cao Cao moves first.'

small.zh: 法正在看地图，嗯了一声。
small.en: Fa Zheng is studying the map. He grunts.

small.zh: 『汉中的山，比成都的冷。』他说。
small.en: 'The mountains at Hanzhong are colder than Chengdu's,' he says.

small.zh: 他把一面小旗插到地图上，又拔了出来。
small.en: He sticks a little flag into the map, then pulls it out again.

threat.zh: 法正抬起眼：『在军中说这种话，你知道是什么罪？』
threat.en: Fa Zheng looks up. 'You know what the penalty is for saying that in camp?'

threat.zh: 他没有叫人，只是把你的话写在了一片竹简上。
threat.en: He calls no one. He just writes your words down on a bamboo slip.

nonsense.zh: 法正打量着你，像在算一笔账。
nonsense.en: Fa Zheng sizes you up, as if working out a sum.

nonsense.zh: 『有意思。』他说完，又低头看地图了。
nonsense.en: 'Interesting,' he says, and goes back to his map.

persona.zh: 法正：病重，这一卷开头就要走了。说话比从前软，账也不记了。称玩家“子衡”。
persona.en: Fa Zheng: gravely ill, and gone early in this volume. He speaks more softly than before and has stopped keeping accounts. Calls the player Ziheng.

warm.zh: 法正把地图推到一边：『来得正好，我正想找个人说说话。』
warm.en: Fa Zheng pushes the map aside. 'Good timing. I wanted someone to talk to.'

neutral.zh: 法正朝对面的席位点了点头。
neutral.en: Fa Zheng nods at the seat across from him.

love.zh: 黄忠哈哈大笑，胡子都抖了起来：『先生拿老夫寻开心！』
love.en: Huang Zhong roars with laughter, his beard shaking. 'You're having fun with an old man, sir!'

love.zh: 『这种话，』他摆摆手，『说给年轻人听去。』
love.en: 'Say that sort of thing,' he waves a hand, 'to the young ones.'

insult.zh: 黄忠把弓往地上一顿：『你说谁老？』
insult.en: Huang Zhong plants his bow on the ground. 'Who are you calling old?'

insult.zh: 『老夫这口刀，还没卷刃！』他瞪着你。
insult.en: 'This old blade hasn't lost its edge yet!' He glares at you.

praise.zh: 黄忠笑得合不拢嘴：『先生有眼光！』
praise.en: Huang Zhong can't stop grinning. 'You've got an eye, sir!'

praise.zh: 『这话，你去跟关将军说一遍。』他得意地说。
praise.en: 'Go say that to General Guan,' he says, pleased with himself.

ask.zh: 黄忠挠挠头：『这个……你问军师去。老夫只管砍人。』
ask.en: Huang Zhong scratches his head. 'That… ask the strategist. I just do the cutting.'

ask.zh: 『打仗的事问我，』他拍着胸口，『别的，老夫不懂。』
ask.en: 'Ask me about fighting,' he thumps his chest. 'The rest, I don't know.'

small.zh: 黄忠在磨刀，嘴里哼着长沙的小调。
small.en: Huang Zhong is sharpening his blade, humming a Changsha tune.

small.zh: 『今晚的饭，硬了些。』他说。
small.en: 'Tonight's rice was a bit hard,' he says.

small.zh: 他拉了拉弓弦，听那一声响。
small.en: He plucks his bowstring and listens to it sing.

threat.zh: 黄忠的刀已经横了过来：『你再说一遍？』
threat.en: Huang Zhong's blade is already across his knees. 'Say that again?'

threat.zh: 『老夫杀过的人，比你见过的还多。』
threat.en: 'I've killed more men than you've ever met.'

nonsense.zh: 黄忠眯起眼看你：『先生喝多了吧？』
nonsense.en: Huang Zhong squints at you. 'Had a few too many, sir?'

nonsense.zh: 『听不懂，』他老实地说，『你说慢点。』
nonsense.en: 'I don't follow,' he says honestly. 'Say it slower.'

persona.zh: 黄忠：七十五岁，最后一仗。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Huang Zhong: seventy-five, his last battle. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 黄忠拍着身边的空地：『先生坐！喝一口长沙的酒！』
warm.en: Huang Zhong slaps the ground beside him. 'Sit, sir! Have some Changsha wine!'

cold.zh: 黄忠擦着刀，只抬了抬眼皮。
cold.en: Huang Zhong keeps polishing his blade and barely lifts his eyes.

neutral.zh: 黄忠往火里添了一根柴：『坐。』
neutral.en: Huang Zhong puts another branch on the fire. 'Sit.'

love.zh: 姜维红了脸：『先生说笑了。』
love.en: Jiang Wei flushes. 'You're joking, Master.'

love.zh: 『伯约不敢当。』他低头行了一礼。
love.en: 'I don't deserve that,' he says, and bows his head.

insult.zh: 姜维的手按上了枪杆，又松开了：『先生是长辈，伯约不还口。』
insult.en: Jiang Wei's hand goes to his spear, then lets go. 'You're my elder, Master. I won't answer back.'

insult.zh: 他沉默了很久，只说：『伯约记下了。』
insult.en: He's silent a long time, then says only, 'I'll remember that.'

praise.zh: 『是丞相教得好。』姜维说，眼睛却亮了。
praise.en: 'It's the Chancellor's teaching,' Jiang Wei says, but his eyes light up.

praise.zh: 姜维笑了，笑得像个少年。
praise.en: Jiang Wei smiles, like the boy he was not long ago.

ask.zh: 姜维想了想，认真地答：『伯约以为……』他一条一条地说给你听。
ask.en: Jiang Wei thinks, then answers in earnest: 'I'd say…' and lays it out for you point by point.

ask.zh: 『这个，伯约也想问丞相。』
ask.en: 'That's something I want to ask the Chancellor too.'

small.zh: 姜维在灯下抄兵书，一笔一画。
small.en: Jiang Wei is copying a book of war by the lamp, stroke by stroke.

small.zh: 『天水这会儿，该下雪了。』他说。
small.en: 'It'll be snowing in Tianshui about now,' he says.

small.zh: 他擦了擦枪头，又看了一眼北边。
small.en: He wipes his spearhead and glances north again.

threat.zh: 姜维站了起来：『先生，这话不该在营里说。』
threat.en: Jiang Wei gets to his feet. 'Master, that shouldn't be said in camp.'

threat.zh: 他挡在你和帐门之间，一句话也没说。
threat.en: He stands between you and the tent flap without a word.

nonsense.zh: 姜维愣了一下：『先生……是在考伯约？』
nonsense.en: Jiang Wei blinks. 'Master… are you testing me?'

nonsense.zh: 他认真地想了半天，还是摇了摇头。
nonsense.en: He thinks about it seriously for a long while, then shakes his head.

persona.zh: 姜维：字伯约，天水冀县人，二十七岁归蜀，孝顺母亲，文武双全；对丞相敬若父师，对你像对一位前辈，问的多、说的少，认准了的事不回头。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Jiang Wei (Boyue): from Ji in Tianshui, came over to Shu at twenty-seven; devoted to his mother, skilled with both brush and spear; he reveres the Chancellor as father and teacher, and treats you as an elder—asks much, says little, and never turns back once he's decided. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 姜维放下笔，站起来：『先生来了。坐。』
warm.en: Jiang Wei sets down his brush and stands. 'Master, you're here. Sit.'

cold.zh: 姜维行了个礼，没有说话。
cold.en: Jiang Wei bows and says nothing.

neutral.en: Jiang Wei makes room for you.

love.zh: 司马懿笑了：『先生这话，懿只当没听见。』
love.en: Sima Yi smiles. 'I'll pretend I didn't hear that, Master.'

love.zh: 『诸葛孔明身边的人，也会说这种话？』
love.en: 'One of Zhuge Kongming's men, talking like that?'

insult.zh: 司马懿一点也不恼：『骂得好。懿记住先生了。』
insult.en: Sima Yi isn't the least put out. 'Well cursed. I'll remember you, Master.'

insult.zh: 他慢慢地端起茶：『蜀中的人，火气都大。』
insult.en: He raises his tea slowly. 'Men from Shu all have such tempers.'

praise.zh: 司马懿摆手：『不敢。懿不过是个守城的。』
praise.en: Sima Yi waves it off. 'Not at all. I'm only a man who holds walls.'

praise.zh: 『先生过誉。』他眼睛里一点笑意也没有。
praise.en: 'Too kind, Master.' There's no smile at all in his eyes.

ask.zh: 司马懿反问：『先生问这个，是替自己问，还是替孔明问？』
ask.en: Sima Yi answers with a question. 'Are you asking for yourself, Master, or for Kongming?'

ask.zh: 『这个嘛，』他慢慢地说，『要看天时。』
ask.en: 'Well,' he says slowly, 'that depends on the season.'

small.zh: 司马懿在看一份军报，看完了，折好，收进袖子里。
small.en: Sima Yi reads a dispatch, folds it neatly, and slips it into his sleeve.

small.zh: 『渭水这几天涨了。』他说。
small.en: 'The Wei has risen these past few days,' he says.

small.zh: 他回头看了一眼，又转了回来。
small.en: He looks back over his shoulder, then turns forward again.

threat.zh: 司马懿身后的卫士拔了刀。司马懿抬手：『收起来。先生是使者。』
threat.en: The guards behind Sima Yi draw their swords. He lifts a hand. 'Put them away. The Master is an envoy.'

threat.zh: 『先生在懿的营里说这话，胆子不小。』
threat.en: 'You've some nerve, Master, saying that in my camp.'

nonsense.zh: 司马懿眯起眼，打量你很久。
nonsense.en: Sima Yi narrows his eyes and studies you for a long time.

nonsense.zh: 『有意思。』他说，『孔明身边，果然都是怪人。』
nonsense.en: 'Interesting,' he says. 'Kongming does keep strange company.'

persona.zh: 司马懿：字仲达，魏国大都督，五十上下；极能忍，宁可被人送女人衣裳也不出战；说话客气，句句是在试探。称玩家“子衡先生”。
persona.en: Sima Yi (Zhongda): grand commander of Wei, about fifty; endlessly patient—he'll accept a gift of women's clothes rather than come out to fight; courteous in speech, every sentence a probe. Calls the player Master Ziheng.

warm.zh: 司马懿亲自给你倒茶：『先生远来辛苦。』
warm.en: Sima Yi pours you tea himself. 'You've come a long way, Master.'

cold.zh: 司马懿没有抬头：『使者请坐。』
cold.en: Sima Yi doesn't look up. 'Be seated, envoy.'

love.zh: 魏延哈哈大笑：『先生是读书读糊涂了！』
love.en: Wei Yan roars with laughter. 'You've read yourself silly, Master!'

love.zh: 『这话，你跟杨仪说去。』他说完，自己先笑了。
love.en: 'Say that to Yang Yi,' he says, and laughs first.

insult.zh: 魏延一把揪住你的衣领，又松开了：『看在丞相面上。』
insult.en: Wei Yan grabs your collar, then lets go. 'For the Chancellor's sake.'

insult.zh: 『你们这些文官……』他啐了一口。
insult.en: 'You civil officials…' He spits.

praise.zh: 魏延很受用：『先生有眼光！比杨仪强。』
praise.en: Wei Yan laps it up. 'You've got an eye, Master! Better than Yang Yi.'

praise.zh: 『这话，丞相要是也这么想就好了。』
praise.en: 'If only the Chancellor thought so too.'

ask.zh: 魏延把地图拍在案上：『问我？子午谷，十天到长安！』
ask.en: Wei Yan slaps the map on the table. 'Ask me? Ziwu Valley—ten days to Chang'an!'

ask.zh: 『这种事，丞相不问我，你倒来问。』
ask.en: 'The Chancellor never asks me about such things, and you do.'

small.zh: 魏延在擦刀，嘴里骂着杨仪。
small.en: Wei Yan is polishing his blade, cursing Yang Yi under his breath.

small.zh: 『又是守。守到什么时候？』他说。
small.en: 'Hold, hold. Hold until when?' he says.

small.zh: 他把马鞭甩得啪啪响。
small.en: He cracks his riding whip.

threat.zh: 魏延的刀已经出鞘了：『你再说一遍？』
threat.en: Wei Yan's blade is already out. 'Say that again?'

threat.zh: 『魏某杀过的人，比你写过的字还多。』
threat.en: 'I've killed more men than you've written characters.'

nonsense.zh: 魏延瞪着你：『先生在说什么？』
nonsense.en: Wei Yan glares at you. 'What are you on about, Master?'

nonsense.zh: 『文官的话，绕得我头疼。』
nonsense.en: 'Civil officials' talk gives me a headache.'

persona.zh: 魏延：字文长，蜀中大将，勇猛，自负，看不起文官，尤其看不起长史杨仪；总想带一支兵走子午谷直取长安，丞相一直不许。称玩家“先生”。
persona.en: Wei Yan (Wenchang): a great general of Shu, brave and arrogant, scornful of civil officials—above all the chief clerk Yang Yi; he keeps asking for one column to go by Ziwu Valley straight at Chang'an, and the Chancellor keeps refusing. Calls the player Master.

warm.zh: 魏延拍着身边的凳子：『先生，坐！喝酒！』
warm.en: Wei Yan slaps the stool beside him. 'Sit, Master! Drink!'

cold.zh: 魏延看了你一眼：『丞相派你来的？』
cold.en: Wei Yan glances at you. 'The Chancellor send you?'

neutral.zh: 魏延哼了一声，算是打了招呼。
neutral.en: Wei Yan grunts by way of greeting.

e_biao.zh: 出师表里那一句，是你添的
e_biao.en: That line in the Memorial was yours

e_ziwu.zh: 你替魏延的子午谷说过话
e_ziwu.en: You spoke up for Wei Yan's Ziwu Valley plan

e_mother.zh: 你劝丞相别拿姜维的母亲做饵
e_mother.en: You urged the Chancellor not to use Jiang Wei's mother as bait

e_road.zh: 街亭那条路口，是你和王平守的
e_road.en: You and Wang Ping held the road at Jieting

e_warned.en: You urged the Chancellor not to send Ma Su

e_wall.en: On the day of the empty city, you were on the wall

e_feud.zh: 你给魏延和杨仪说过和
e_feud.en: You tried to make peace between Wei Yan and Yang Yi

e_envoy.zh: 你在司马懿帐里说过丞相的事
e_envoy.en: You spoke of the Chancellor in Sima Yi's tent

e_child.zh: 北伐那年，你的孩子出生了
e_child.en: The year of the northern march, your child was born

text.zh: 南中平定两年了。曹丕死了，他的儿子曹睿做了魏帝。丞相说：是时候了。
text.en: Two years since the south was pacified. Cao Pi is dead, and his son Cao Rui is emperor of Wei. The Chancellor says: it's time.

text.zh: 你五十多了。早上起来，膝盖会疼。
text.en: You're past fifty now. Your knees ache in the mornings.

text.zh: 大军出了祁山。南安、安定、天水三郡，一个月里降了两个。只有天水的冀县，有一个年轻人，看穿了丞相的计。
text.en: The army comes out of Qishan. Of Nan'an, Anding and Tianshui, two commanderies surrender within a month. Only at Ji in Tianshui, a young man sees through the Chancellor's plan.

text.zh: 司马懿复出了，直扑街亭。街亭是汉中的咽喉。丞相问：谁去守？
text.en: Sima Yi has returned to command and is driving straight for Jieting. Jieting is the throat of Hanzhong. The Chancellor asks: who will hold it?

text.zh: 街亭丢了。司马懿的十五万大军，正往西城来。城里只有两千五百人，大将都派出去了。
text.en: Jieting is lost. Sima Yi's hundred and fifty thousand are marching on Xicheng. There are twenty-five hundred men in the city, and every general has been sent elsewhere.

text.zh: 大军退回汉中。马谡被绑着，送到了丞相帐前。
text.en: The army falls back to Hanzhong. Ma Su is brought before the Chancellor's tent in bonds.

text.zh: 出了几次祁山，拿下了武都、阴平，可长安还是很远。成都传来消息：赵云病重。
text.en: Several marches on Qishan; Wudu and Yinping taken, but Chang'an is still far away. Word comes from Chengdu: Zhao Yun is gravely ill.

text.zh: 最后一次北伐。大军屯在五丈原，木牛流马运着粮。司马懿就是不出战。
text.en: The last northern march. The army is camped on the Wuzhang Plains, grain hauled by wooden oxen and gliding horses. Sima Yi simply will not come out and fight.

text.zh: 入秋以后，丞相病倒了，吐了好几回血。他夜里出帐看天，回来以后一句话也不说。
text.en: When autumn comes, the Chancellor falls ill and coughs blood more than once. He goes out of his tent at night to look at the sky, and comes back without a word.

title.en: A Letter from an Old Friend

text.zh: 你离开蜀中已经很多年了。
text.en: You left Shu many years ago.

text.zh: 你在北方住了很多年，头发白了一半。
text.en: You've lived in the north many years; your hair is half white.

text.zh: 丞相的信只有一句：『亮要北伐了。子衡兄，再陪亮走一程。』
text.en: The Chancellor's letter is one line: 'I'm going north. Ziheng—walk one more stretch with me.'

label.en: Set out for Hanzhong.

text.zh: 丞相在营门口等你，瘦得你差点没认出来。他笑着说：『来了就好。』
text.en: The Chancellor waits at the camp gate, so thin you almost don't know him. He smiles. 'You came. Good.'

label.en: Put the letter away. You won't go.

text.zh: 几年以后，你听说丞相死在了五丈原。
text.en: Some years later you hear the Chancellor died on the Wuzhang Plains.

text.zh: 出兵前一夜，丞相把写好的表给你看。开头一句：『先帝创业未半，而中道崩殂；今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也。』后面写到自己：『臣本布衣，躬耕南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯。』他问你：『子衡兄，还缺什么？』
text.en: The night before the march, the Chancellor shows you the memorial he has written. It begins: the late emperor's great work was not half done when he fell midway; now the realm is split in three, Yi province is exhausted, and truly this is a moment of life and death. Further on, of himself: he was a commoner who ploughed at Nanyang, only seeking to keep alive in troubled times, not to be known among the lords. 'Ziheng,' he asks, 'what's missing?'

text.zh: 你想起白帝城里，先帝把你们两个人的手放在一起。
text.en: You remember Baidi, and the late emperor laying your two hands together.

label.zh: 说：多写几个能用的人名。丞相走了，陛下得知道该问谁。
label.en: Say: name more of the men he can rely on. With you gone, His Majesty must know whom to ask.

text.zh: 丞相点头，提笔加上了郭攸之、费祎、董允、向宠的名字。他写完，看了你一眼：『子衡兄的名字，亮就不写了。你跟我走。』
text.en: The Chancellor nods and adds the names of Guo Youzhi, Fei Yi, Dong Yun and Xiang Chong. When he's done he glances at you. 'I won't write yours, Ziheng. You're coming with me.'

label.en: Say: nothing's missing.

text.zh: 丞相把表卷起来：『今当远离，临表涕泣，不知所云。』他念完最后一句，自己笑了笑，眼睛是红的。
text.en: The Chancellor rolls it up. 'Now that I go far away, I weep over this memorial and don't know what I've said.' He reads out the last line, gives a small laugh, and his eyes are red.

label.zh: 说：丞相该多写一句——自己保重。
label.en: Say: you should add one more line, Chancellor—take care of yourself.

text.zh: 丞相摇头：『这个，不能写。』
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head. 'That can't be written.'

quote.zh: 先帝创业未半，而中道崩殂；……臣本布衣，躬耕南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯。……今当远离，临表涕泣，不知所云。
quote.en: The late emperor's work was not half done when he fell midway… I was a commoner who ploughed at Nanyang, seeking only to keep alive in a troubled age, not to be known among the lords… Now I go far away; I weep over this memorial and know not what I say.

text.zh: 出兵前，温芷把你拉到院子里那棵梅树下，压低了声音：『我有了。』她看着你：『你去吧。等你回来，孩子会叫人了。』
text.en: Before the march, Wen Zhi draws you under the plum tree in the yard and lowers her voice. 'I'm with child.' She looks at you. 'Go. By the time you're back, it'll be able to say your name.'

label.en: Hold her. 'I'll come back.'

text.zh: 那年冬天，你在汉中收到家书：是个孩子，母子平安。温芷在信里写：名字等你回来起。
text.en: That winter a letter reaches you in Hanzhong: a child, mother and child both well. Wen Zhi writes: the name waits for you to come home.

label.zh: 说：你和孩子都留在成都，别随军了。
label.en: Say: you and the child stay in Chengdu. No more following the army.

text.zh: 温芷想了很久，点了头：『这一回，听你的。』那年冬天，孩子出生了。
text.en: Wen Zhi thinks a long time and nods. 'This once, I'll listen to you.' That winter the child is born.

text.zh: 出兵前最后一夜，丞相没睡。他把灯拨暗了些：『子衡兄，陪亮坐坐。』
text.en: On the last night before the march, the Chancellor doesn't sleep. He turns the lamp down. 'Ziheng, sit with me.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，丞相说：『明天，就从这里出发。』
text.en: As you leave, the Chancellor says, 'Tomorrow we set out from here.'

label.zh: 问他：这一仗，有几分把握？
label.en: Ask him: how sure are you of this war?

text.zh: 丞相想了很久：『先帝说过，汉贼不两立，王业不偏安。』他没有回答几分。
text.en: The Chancellor thinks a long time. 'The late emperor said: Han and the usurper cannot both stand; a king's work can't settle for a corner.' He doesn't say how sure.

label.en: Say: you've grown thin, Chancellor.

text.zh: 丞相摸了摸自己的脸，笑了：『子衡兄也老了。』
text.en: The Chancellor touches his own face and smiles. 'You've grown old too, Ziheng.'

label.en: Speak of Longzhong.

text.zh: 丞相望着灯：『那年在草庐里，亮对先帝说了三分天下。如今三分了，亮还欠先帝一个“兴复汉室”。』
text.en: The Chancellor looks at the lamp. 'That year in the cottage, I told the late emperor the realm would split in three. It has. I still owe him the restoration of the Han.'

text.zh: 温芷又收拾了药箱：『北边冷，冻伤的人会多。』
text.en: Wen Zhi packs her medicine chest again. 'It's cold in the north. There'll be frostbite.'

label.en: Let her come.

text.zh: 她把药箱背上了车。
text.en: She heaves the chest onto the cart.

label.en: Ask her to stay at the clinic in Chengdu.

text.zh: 她说：『那我把冻伤的方子写给你。』
text.en: She says, 'Then I'll write out the frostbite remedies for you.'

text.zh: 陛下私下召你进宫，问：『相父这一去，朕在成都，该做什么？』
text.en: His Majesty summons you privately. 'While the Father Chancellor is away, what should We do in Chengdu?'

label.zh: 说：每天读一遍相父的表。
label.en: Say: read the Chancellor's memorial once a day.

text.zh: 陛下笑了：『那朕就背下来。』
text.en: His Majesty laughs. 'Then We'll learn it by heart.'

label.zh: 说：多问董允。他会说难听的话，难听的话最有用。
label.en: Say: ask Dong Yun often. He'll say unpleasant things, and unpleasant things are the most useful.

text.zh: 陛下愣了一下，点头。后来董允常常把话说得很难听，陛下也常常听。
text.en: His Majesty starts, then nods. Later Dong Yun often says unpleasant things, and His Majesty often listens.

text.zh: 魏延请战：给他五千精兵，出子午谷，十天就到长安城下。丞相不许：太险。魏延不服，转过头来看你：『先生说句公道话！』
text.en: Wei Yan asks to go: give him five thousand picked men, out by Ziwu Valley, and in ten days he'll be under the walls of Chang'an. The Chancellor refuses: too risky. Wei Yan won't accept it, and turns to you. 'Master, say something fair!'

label.en: Say: it's risky, but worth trying.

text.zh: 丞相还是没准。魏延看你的眼神不一样了：『全营只有先生懂我。』丞相看了你一眼，没说话。
text.en: The Chancellor still won't allow it. But Wei Yan looks at you differently now. 'In this whole camp only the Master understands me.' The Chancellor glances at you and says nothing.

label.zh: 说：丞相用兵，求的是万全。子午谷一失，五千人就没了。
label.en: Say: the Chancellor seeks a sure thing. Lose Ziwu Valley and five thousand men are gone.

text.zh: 魏延冷笑：『你们文官，都一个样。』他甩帘子出去了。
text.en: Wei Yan laughs coldly. 'You civil officials are all the same.' He flings the curtain aside and walks out.

label.zh: 说：子午谷可以先派人去探一探。
label.en: Say: send someone to scout Ziwu Valley first.

text.zh: 丞相准了。探马回来说，谷里有魏兵。魏延没再说话。
text.en: The Chancellor agrees. The scouts report Wei troops in the valley. Wei Yan says no more.

text.zh: 天水冀县的姜维，看穿了丞相的计，赵云都没占到便宜。丞相大喜，要收这个人。有人献计：姜维是孝子，母亲在冀县，假装去攻冀县，他必回城救母。丞相看你：『子衡兄以为如何？』
text.en: Jiang Wei of Ji in Tianshui saw through the Chancellor's plan; not even Zhao Yun could get the better of him. The Chancellor is delighted and wants the man. Someone proposes: Jiang Wei is a devoted son with his mother in Ji; pretend to attack Ji, and he'll come back to save her. The Chancellor looks at you. 'What do you think, Ziheng?'

label.zh: 说：用他母亲做饵，他就算来了，心也不在这里。
label.en: Say: use his mother as bait and even if he comes, his heart won't be here.

text.zh: 丞相想了想：『那就让他母亲平平安安。』后来姜维被逼得无处可去，下马投降。他第一句话问的是：『我母亲呢？』你说：平安。他朝你深深一拜。
text.en: The Chancellor considers. 'Then his mother stays safe.' In the end Jiang Wei, cornered with nowhere to go, dismounts and surrenders. His first words: 'My mother?' Safe, you say. He bows deeply to you.

label.zh: 说：此计可行。孝子，正是可用之人。
label.en: Say: the plan works. A devoted son is exactly the kind of man worth having.

text.zh: 计成了。姜维走投无路，下马投降。丞相亲手扶起他：『吾自出茅庐以来，遍求贤者……今遇伯约，吾愿足矣。』姜维看了你一眼。你知道他记住了这个计是谁赞成的。
text.en: The plan works. With nowhere to go, Jiang Wei dismounts and surrenders. The Chancellor raises him with his own hands: since leaving the thatched cottage he has sought worthy men everywhere… now that he has found Boyue, his wish is fulfilled. Jiang Wei glances at you. You know he's remembered who approved the plan.

label.zh: 说：让我去冀县城下，跟他说几句话。
label.en: Say: let me go below the walls of Ji and speak with him.

text.zh: 你在城下喊了半天，姜维在城上一句也没回。可几天后他投降时，第一个找的是你：『那天城下的人，是先生？』
text.en: You shout below the walls half the day, and Jiang Wei on the walls answers not a word. But when he surrenders days later, the first person he looks for is you. 'The man below the walls that day—was that you, Master?'

quote.zh: 我今降蜀，加为上将，安有还魏之理？……今遇伯约，吾愿足矣。
quote.en: "I have come over to Shu and been made a general—how could I go back to Wei?" … "Now that I have met Boyue, my wish is fulfilled."

q.zh: 那天夜里，姜维来找你，跪在你面前：『先生，我母亲在冀县，我降了蜀。你说，我是不是不孝？』
q.en: That night Jiang Wei comes to you and kneels. 'Master, my mother is in Ji, and I've come over to Shu. Tell me—am I an unfilial son?'

text.zh: 姜维的脸白了。他站起来，行了一礼，走了。
text.en: Jiang Wei goes pale. He gets up, bows, and leaves.

means.en: says no—loyalty and filial duty can't always both be kept

text.zh: 姜维的眼泪掉了下来：『先生……』他磕了一个头。
text.en: Tears fall from Jiang Wei's eyes. 'Master…' He knocks his head once.

answers.match: 不是|两全|忠|没有不孝|she would understand|no|loyal|can't have both

text.zh: 姜维点头：『伯约每个月都写。』
text.en: Jiang Wei nods. 'I'll write every month.'

answers.match: 写信|书信|家书|消息|write|letter|send word

text.zh: 姜维没有再问。
text.en: Jiang Wei doesn't ask again.

text.zh: 魏国的司徒王朗，七十六岁，在两军阵前劝丞相投降。丞相坐在车上，听他说完，问你：『子衡兄，亮回他，还是你回他？』
text.en: Wang Lang, Minister over the Masses of Wei, seventy-six years old, rides out between the lines to urge the Chancellor to surrender. The Chancellor sits in his carriage, hears him out, and asks you, 'Ziheng, shall I answer him, or will you?'

label.en: Say: you answer him, Chancellor.

text.zh: 丞相开口：『皓首匹夫！苍髯老贼！汝即日将归于九泉之下，何面目见二十四帝乎！』王朗听罢，气满胸膛，大叫一声，撞死于马下。
text.en: The Chancellor speaks: white-headed fool, grey-bearded old traitor—you'll soon go down to the Nine Springs; with what face will you meet the twenty-four emperors of Han? Hearing this, Wang Lang's chest swells with rage; he gives a great cry and falls dead from his horse.

label.en: Answer yourself, and leave him some room.

text.zh: 你说得很客气，王朗也答得很客气，两边各自收兵。丞相事后说：『子衡兄心软。』他没说是好是坏。
text.en: You speak courteously, Wang Lang answers courteously, and both sides withdraw. Afterward the Chancellor says, 'You're soft-hearted, Ziheng.' He doesn't say whether that's good or bad.

quote.zh: 皓首匹夫！苍髯老贼！汝即日将归于九泉之下，何面目见二十四帝乎！
quote.en: White-headed fool! Grey-bearded old traitor! Soon you will go down to the Nine Springs—with what face will you meet the twenty-four emperors?

text.zh: 马谡出班：『某自幼熟读兵书，颇知兵法。岂一街亭不能守耶？』他愿立军令状。丞相看着他，又看你。
text.en: Ma Su steps forward: he has studied the books of war since childhood; can he not hold one Jieting? He offers to sign a pledge on his life. The Chancellor looks at him, then at you.

text.zh: 你想起白帝城里，先帝压低声音说的那句话。你在南征路上，也跟丞相说过。
text.en: You remember what the late emperor said in Baidi, his voice very low. You told the Chancellor, too, on the march south.

text.zh: 你当众夸过他的“攻心为上”。他也看了你一眼，像在等你开口。
text.en: You once praised his 'win their hearts' in front of everyone. He glances at you too, as if waiting for you to speak.

label.zh: 自请随马谡去街亭，做他的参军。
label.en: Ask to go to Jieting with Ma Su as his adviser.

text.zh: 丞相想了想，准了，又派王平为副将。临走前他拉住你：『当道扎营，切记。』
text.en: The Chancellor considers and agrees, sending Wang Ping as his deputy as well. Before you go he takes your arm. 'Camp on the road. Don't forget.'

label.zh: 说：派他去可以，王平为副；令他当道扎营，画好营图送回来。
label.en: Say: send him if you like, with Wang Ping as deputy; order him to camp on the road and send back a drawing of the camp.

text.zh: 丞相照你说的下了令。马谡领命去了。
text.en: The Chancellor gives the orders as you said. Ma Su takes his command and goes.

label.zh: 说：先帝说过，此人言过其实。换人。
label.en: Say: the late emperor said this man's words outrun his worth. Send someone else.

text.zh: 丞相沉默了很久。马谡跪下立了军令状：『若有差失，乞斩全家。』丞相叹了口气，还是让他去了。
text.en: The Chancellor is silent a long while. Ma Su kneels and signs the pledge: if he fails, let his whole family die. The Chancellor sighs, and sends him all the same.

text.zh: 到了街亭，马谡看了地势，笑丞相多虑：『此处侧边一山，四面皆不相连，且树木极广，此乃天赐之险也。可就山上屯军。』王平急了：『参军差矣：若屯兵当道，筑起城垣，贼兵总有十万，不能偷过；今若弃此要路，屯兵于山上，倘魏兵骤至，四面围定，将何策保之？』两人都看着你。
text.en: At Jieting Ma Su surveys the ground and laughs at the Chancellor's caution: here beside the road is a hill, cut off on all sides and thickly wooded—a natural stronghold; camp on the hill. Wang Ping is alarmed: if we wall the road, a hundred thousand couldn't slip past; abandon the road for the hill, and if Wei arrives and surrounds us, how will we hold? Both of them look at you.

label.zh: 站到王平一边。马谡不听，你就和王平带一千人，守在当道的路口。
label.en: Side with Wang Ping. If Ma Su won't listen, take a thousand men with Wang Ping and hold the road.

text.zh: 马谡上了山。司马懿到了，围山断水，山上的兵渴得自己乱了。马谡败下来的时候，是你和王平在路口接住了他，一路且战且退，带回来的人，比原来多了一半。
text.en: Ma Su goes up the hill. Sima Yi arrives, surrounds it and cuts off the water; the men on the hill go mad with thirst. When Ma Su is driven down, it's you and Wang Ping at the road who catch him and fall back fighting; half again as many men come home as would have.

label.zh: 劝马谡：要上山也行，先派兵守住山下的水源。
label.en: Urge Ma Su: if you must go up, first post men to hold the water below.

text.zh: 马谡想了想，派了五百人。司马懿第一件事，就是把那五百人围了。山上还是断了水。
text.en: Ma Su thinks and sends five hundred. The first thing Sima Yi does is surround those five hundred. The hill still loses its water.

label.en: Go with Ma Su. He's in command.

text.zh: 司马懿围山断水。山上的兵乱了，街亭丢了。你跟着马谡逃下山的时候，听见身后在喊。
text.en: Sima Yi surrounds the hill and cuts the water. The men on the hill break, and Jieting is lost. As you flee down the hill with Ma Su, you hear the shouting behind you.

quote.zh: 此处侧边一山，四面皆不相连，且树木极广，此乃天赐之险也。……今若弃此要路，屯兵于山上，倘魏兵骤至，四面围定，将何策保之？
quote.en: "Beside the road is a hill, cut off on every side and thickly wooded—Heaven's own stronghold." … "If we abandon this vital road and camp on the hill, and Wei arrives suddenly and surrounds us, how will we hold?"

text.zh: 丞相下令：旌旗都藏起来，大开四门，每门二十个兵扮作百姓扫街。他披上鹤氅，戴上纶巾，带两个小童，抱一张琴，上了城楼，焚香操琴。远远地，司马懿的大军到了。
text.en: The Chancellor gives his orders: hide every banner, throw open all four gates, and at each gate twenty soldiers dressed as townsfolk sweep the street. He puts on his crane-feather cloak and silk cap, takes two boys and a zither up to the gate tower, lights incense and plays. In the distance Sima Yi's army arrives.

text.zh: 你在城里。丞相回头看了你一眼：『子衡兄，你站哪里？』
text.en: You're in the city. The Chancellor looks back at you. 'Ziheng, where will you stand?'

label.zh: 上城楼，站在他身边，给他添香。
label.en: Go up the tower and stand at his side, tending the incense.

text.zh: 司马懿在城下看了很久。你看见他的脸，也看见他在看你。他说：『亮平生谨慎，不曾弄险。今大开城门，必有埋伏。』魏军退了。丞相的手指停下的时候，在发抖。
text.en: Sima Yi looks up from below a long time. You see his face, and see him looking at you. He says Liang has been cautious all his life and never gambled; with the gates wide open there must be an ambush. The Wei army withdraws. When the Chancellor's fingers stop on the strings, they're shaking.

label.zh: 换上百姓的衣服，去城门口扫街。
label.en: Put on townsman's clothes and sweep the street at the gate.

text.zh: 魏军的先锋到了门口，看着你扫地。你没有抬头。后来他们退了，你才发现扫帚柄被你攥裂了。
text.en: Wei's vanguard reaches the gate and watches you sweep. You don't look up. They withdraw, and only then do you notice you've cracked the broom handle in your grip.

label.en: Urge the Chancellor to leave by the back gate.

text.zh: 丞相笑着摇头：『走，就走不掉了。』他接着弹琴。魏军退了。
text.en: The Chancellor smiles and shakes his head. 'If we run, we won't get away.' He keeps playing. The Wei army withdraws.

quote.zh: 孔明乃披鹤氅，戴纶巾，引二小童携琴一张，于城上敌楼前，凭栏而坐，焚香操琴。……亮平生谨慎，不曾弄险。今大开城门，必有埋伏。
quote.en: Kongming put on his crane-feather cloak and silk cap, took two boys carrying a zither, sat at the rail before the gate tower, lit incense and played. … "Liang has been cautious all his life and never taken a gamble. Now the gates are wide open—there must be an ambush."

text.zh: 城里的两千五百人里，有一半是你和王平从街亭带回来的。
text.en: Half of the twenty-five hundred in the city are men you and Wang Ping brought back from Jieting.

text.zh: 丞相要斩马谡。众将求情，丞相流着泪说：『昔孙武所以能制胜于天下者，用法明也。』马谡被推出去的时候，回头看你。
text.en: The Chancellor means to behead Ma Su. The generals plead; weeping, the Chancellor says that Sun Wu could prevail across the realm because his law was clear. As Ma Su is led out, he looks back at you.

text.zh: 街亭那条路口，是你和王平守住的。带回来的人里，有一半是马谡的兵。
text.en: You and Wang Ping held the road at Jieting. Half of the men you brought back were Ma Su's.

label.zh: 跪下：街亭之败，臣在场，臣也有罪。马谡的命，留着；他的官，削了。
label.en: Kneel: I was at Jieting, and the defeat is mine too. Spare Ma Su's life; strip him of his rank.

text.zh: 丞相看着你，眼泪流了下来。很久，他说：『杖八十，削为庶人，永不叙用。』马谡被抬下去的时候，抓着你的袖子，什么也说不出。
text.en: The Chancellor looks at you and the tears run down. After a long time he says: eighty strokes, stripped to a commoner, never to serve again. As Ma Su is carried away, he clutches your sleeve and can't say a word.

text.zh: 丞相又哭先帝：『吾思先帝在白帝城临危之时曾嘱吾曰：马谡言过其实，不可大用。』
text.en: Then the Chancellor weeps for the late emperor: he remembers how the late emperor, near death at Baidi, told him Ma Su's words outran his worth and he must not be given great charge.

label.en: Kneel and plead for Ma Su.

text.zh: 丞相摇头，泪流满面：『他立了军令状。』马谡还是被斩了。丞相上表：『请自贬三等，以督阙咎。』
text.en: The Chancellor shakes his head, tears streaming. 'He signed the pledge.' Ma Su is executed all the same. The Chancellor writes to the throne, asking to be demoted three grades for his own fault.

label.zh: 不说话。军令状是他自己立的。
label.en: Say nothing. He signed the pledge himself.

text.zh: 马谡被斩了。丞相哭了很久，又哭先帝：『吾思先帝在白帝城临危之时曾嘱吾曰：马谡言过其实，不可大用。』
text.en: Ma Su is executed. The Chancellor weeps a long time, and then weeps for the late emperor: at Baidi, near death, the late emperor warned him Ma Su's words outran his worth.

label.zh: 答应马谡：他的家小，你来照看。
label.en: Promise Ma Su: you'll look after his family.

text.zh: 马谡磕了一个头。后来，他的家小每月都收到一份钱粮，不知道是谁送的。
text.en: Ma Su knocks his head once. Afterward his family receives money and grain every month, and never learns from whom.

quote.zh: 昔孙武所以能制胜于天下者，用法明也。……请自贬三等，以督阙咎。
quote.en: "Sun Wu prevailed across the realm because his law was clear." … "I ask to be demoted three grades, to answer for my fault."

text.zh: 丞相说：『子衡兄劝过亮。是亮不听。』
text.en: The Chancellor says, 'You warned me, Ziheng. I wouldn't listen.'

text.zh: 姜维每天夜里在丞相帐外抄兵书，抄完一卷，就来问你哪里没懂。今晚他问：『街亭，若是先生守，会怎么守？』
text.en: Every night Jiang Wei copies books of war outside the Chancellor's tent, and when he finishes a scroll he comes to ask you what he didn't follow. Tonight he asks, 'Jieting—if you'd held it, Master, how would you have done it?'

label.zh: 在地上画给他看：当道，筑垒，引水。
label.en: Draw it for him in the dirt: on the road, walls, water.

text.zh: 姜维看了很久，把你画的图描在了纸上。
text.en: Jiang Wei studies it a long time and copies your drawing onto paper.

label.zh: 说：守街亭靠的不是图，是人。先看清派去的是谁。
label.en: Say: Jieting isn't held by maps but by men. First see clearly who you send.

text.zh: 姜维沉默了：『伯约记下了。』
text.en: Jiang Wei is quiet. 'I'll remember.'

text.zh: 温芷的信到了。信里夹着一张纸，上面是孩子的小手印。
text.en: A letter from Wen Zhi. Folded inside is a sheet with a tiny handprint on it.

text.zh: 温芷的信到了：医馆收了几个冻伤的兵，问你在北边冷不冷。
text.en: A letter from Wen Zhi: the clinic has taken in a few frostbitten soldiers, and she asks if you're cold in the north.

label.en: Write back, a long letter.

text.zh: 你写了一夜。天亮时，信纸摞了一指厚。
text.en: You write all night. By dawn the pages are a finger thick.

label.en: Write back one line: safe.

text.zh: 她回信说：一句也好。
text.en: She writes back: one line is enough.

text.zh: 你从汉中赶回成都。赵云躺在床上，听见你进来，挣扎着要坐起来：『先生……来得正好。』
text.en: You hurry back from Hanzhong to Chengdu. Zhao Yun lies in bed; hearing you come in, he struggles to sit up. 'Master… just in time.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 几天以后，赵云去世了。丞相在汉中听到消息，跌足而哭，说自己去了一条臂膀。
text.en: A few days later Zhao Yun dies. In Hanzhong the Chancellor hears the news, stamps his foot and weeps, saying he has lost an arm.

label.en: Speak of Changban.

text.zh: 赵云笑了：『那天我抱着阿斗……阿斗如今是陛下了。』他闭上眼，『值了。』
text.en: Zhao Yun smiles. 'That day I held A Dou… A Dou is His Majesty now.' He closes his eyes. 'It was worth it.'

label.en: Tell him about the north.

text.zh: 赵云听得很认真，听到街亭，叹了口气；听到空城，笑出了声。『丞相……要保重。』
text.en: Zhao Yun listens carefully; at Jieting he sighs, and at the empty city he laughs aloud. 'The Chancellor… must take care.'

label.en: Ask him: that spear—who gets it?

text.zh: 赵云想了想：『给伯约吧。他用得上。』
text.en: Zhao Yun thinks. 'Give it to Boyue. He'll have use for it.'

text.zh: 关羽也老了。他在成都病倒的那个冬天，让人去汉中叫你。你赶到的时候，他已经说不了几句话。他握着你的手：『子衡……麦城那回，谢了。』
text.en: Guan Yu has grown old too. The winter he falls ill in Chengdu, he sends to Hanzhong for you. By the time you arrive he can barely speak. He takes your hand. 'Ziheng… Maicheng. Thank you.'

text.zh: 张飞老了，喝不动酒了。他病倒的那个冬天，让人去汉中叫你。他拉着你的手，嗓门还是很大：『先生！阆中那一夜……俺记着！』
text.en: Zhang Fei has grown old and can't drink anymore. The winter he falls ill, he sends to Hanzhong for you. He grips your hand, his voice still loud. 'Master! That night at Langzhong… I remember!'

label.en: Stay with him to the end.

text.zh: 他走得很安静。桃园里结义的三个人，到这里都走完了。你在他床边坐到天亮。
text.en: He goes quietly. The three who swore brotherhood in the peach garden have all gone now. You sit by his bed until dawn.

label.zh: 给他讲北伐的事，讲到他睡着。
label.en: Tell him about the northern march until he falls asleep.

text.zh: 你讲到空城，他笑了一声，就再没有醒。
text.en: When you get to the empty city he laughs once, and never wakes again.

text.zh: 魏延又和长史杨仪吵了起来。魏延拔了刀，杨仪哭着去找丞相。丞相两边都舍不得，把你叫来：『子衡兄，这两个人，你看怎么办？』
text.en: Wei Yan has quarrelled with the chief clerk Yang Yi again. Wei Yan drew his blade, and Yang Yi went weeping to the Chancellor. The Chancellor can spare neither, and sends for you. 'Ziheng, what do we do about these two?'

label.zh: 去魏延营里，跟他喝一夜酒，再去杨仪那里坐一夜。
label.en: Go to Wei Yan's camp and drink with him all night, then sit up a night with Yang Yi.

text.zh: 两个人都给了你面子，那个月没再吵。魏延说：『先生是个实在人。』杨仪说：『先生太好说话了。』
text.en: Both of them give you face, and they don't quarrel again that month. Wei Yan says, 'The Master is a straight man.' Yang Yi says, 'The Master is too easygoing.'

label.zh: 说：一个管前军，一个管粮草，别让他们在一个帐里。
label.en: Say: give one the vanguard and the other the supplies, and keep them out of the same tent.

text.zh: 丞相照办了。两个人见面少了，仇却没少。
text.en: The Chancellor does it. They meet less, but the hatred doesn't lessen.

label.en: Say: Wei Yan drew his blade. That's wrong, plain and simple.

text.zh: 魏延知道了，从此看见你就扭头。
text.en: Wei Yan hears of it, and from then on turns his head away whenever he sees you.

text.zh: 魏延说：『子午谷那回，只有先生替我说话。』
text.en: Wei Yan says, 'At Ziwu Valley, only you spoke for me, Master.'

text.zh: 营里有个年轻的书佐，十九岁，字写得好，话很少，每天替你誊抄文书。今天他鼓起勇气问你：『先生，我能跟您学吗？』
text.en: There's a young clerk in camp, nineteen, with a fine hand and few words, who copies your documents every day. Today he works up the courage to ask, 'Master, may I study with you?'

label.en: Take him on.

text.zh: 他跪下磕了三个头。从那天起，你说的话，他都记在一个本子上。
text.en: He kneels and knocks his head three times. From that day on he writes down everything you say in a notebook.

label.en: Say: you should study under Jiang Wei.

text.zh: 他去了。后来他跟着姜维，打了很多年仗。
text.en: He goes. Later he follows Jiang Wei through many years of war.

text.zh: 丞相在上方谷里埋了地雷火药，让魏延诱司马懿进谷。司马懿父子果然进来了。火起的时候，忽然下起了倾盆大雨，火全灭了。丞相叹道：『谋事在人，成事在天。不可强也！』
text.en: The Chancellor has buried fire and powder in Shangfang Valley and sends Wei Yan to lure Sima Yi in. Sima Yi and his sons do come in. Just as the fire takes, a downpour falls and puts it all out. The Chancellor sighs: man proposes, Heaven disposes; it can't be forced.

text.zh: 魏延退出谷来，满脸烟灰，大骂：谷口的火，差点把他也烧在里面。
text.en: Wei Yan comes out of the valley, his face black with smoke, cursing: the fire at the valley mouth nearly burned him in there too.

label.zh: 火起之前，你就派人告诉魏延：出谷别走谷口。
label.en: Before the fire, you sent word to Wei Yan: don't come out by the valley mouth.

text.zh: 魏延从侧边的小路出来，身上一点灰都没有。他找到你，什么也没说，给你倒了一碗酒。
text.en: Wei Yan comes out by a side path without a speck of ash on him. He finds you, says nothing, and pours you a bowl of wine.

label.zh: 去劝魏延：火是冲着司马懿的，不是冲着你。
label.en: Go and calm Wei Yan: the fire was meant for Sima Yi, not you.

text.zh: 魏延不信：『那谷口为什么要烧？』你答不上来。
text.en: Wei Yan doesn't believe it. 'Then why was the valley mouth set to burn?' You have no answer.

label.en: Say nothing. Watch the rain.

text.zh: 雨下了一整夜。丞相在帐里咳了一整夜。
text.en: It rains all night. The Chancellor coughs all night in his tent.

quote.zh: 谋事在人，成事在天。不可强也！
quote.en: Man proposes; Heaven disposes. It cannot be forced!

text.zh: 魏延说：『先生给我和杨仪说过和。这回，杨仪在丞相面前怎么说我，先生也听见了吧？』
text.en: Wei Yan says, 'You made peace between me and Yang Yi once, Master. This time—you heard what Yang Yi said about me to the Chancellor, didn't you?'

text.zh: 司马懿坚守不出。丞相让人把一套女人的衣裳装进盒子，派使者送去。他问：谁去？
text.en: Sima Yi holds fast and won't come out. The Chancellor has a set of women's clothes packed in a box and sent by envoy. Who goes, he asks.

text.zh: 你去了。司马懿打开盒子，笑了笑，收下了，还请你喝茶。他不问打仗的事，只问：『孔明寝食及事之烦简若何？』
text.en: You go. Sima Yi opens the box, smiles, accepts it, and invites you to tea. He asks nothing about the war—only how Kongming eats and sleeps, and how heavy his work is.

label.zh: 照实说：丞相每天睡得很少，吃得很少，二十杖以上的罚，都要亲自看。
label.en: Tell the truth: the Chancellor sleeps little, eats little, and personally reviews every punishment of twenty strokes or more.

text.zh: 司马懿点点头，送你出营。你走出很远，听见他对身边的人说：『孔明食少事烦，其能久乎！』
text.en: Sima Yi nods and sees you out. You're well away before you hear him say to those beside him that Kongming eats little and works much—how long can he last?

label.zh: 说：丞相一顿能吃三碗饭。
label.en: Say: the Chancellor eats three bowls of rice at a sitting.

text.zh: 司马懿看着你，笑了：『先生的脸色，比你的话诚实。』
text.en: Sima Yi looks at you and smiles. 'Your face is more honest than your words, Master.'

label.zh: 说：丞相的事，不劳都督挂念。
label.en: Say: the Chancellor's affairs needn't concern the Grand Commander.

text.zh: 司马懿也不恼：『好。先生请回。』
text.en: Sima Yi isn't put out. 'Very well. You may go, Master.'

quote.zh: 孔明食少事烦，其能久乎！
quote.en: Kongming eats little and works much—how long can he last?

q.zh: 送你出营的时候，司马懿走在你旁边，忽然问：『子衡先生，你跟了孔明这么多年。你说，你们这样打下去，图什么？』
q.en: Seeing you out of the camp, Sima Yi walks beside you and suddenly asks, 'Master Ziheng, you've followed Kongming all these years. Tell me—what are you fighting for, going on like this?'

text.zh: 司马懿哈哈大笑：『懿图的，是活得比他长。』
text.en: Sima Yi laughs aloud. 'What I'm after is outliving him.'

answers.match: 你呢|你图|你又|都督|and you|what about you|you\?

text.zh: 司马懿看了你很久：『孔明有你，是他的福气。』
text.en: Sima Yi looks at you a long time. 'Kongming is lucky to have you.'

text.zh: 司马懿笑了：『汉室……』他没有说下去，只是点了点头。
text.en: Sima Yi smiles. 'The Han…' He doesn't go on; he only nods.

answers.match: 汉室|兴复|先帝|汉|for the han|restore|the late emperor

text.zh: 司马懿也不追问：『先生慢走。』
text.en: Sima Yi doesn't press. 'Safe travels, Master.'

text.zh: 姜维在营外站岗，替丞相守夜。他看见你，压低了声音：『先生，丞相今夜又吐血了。』
text.en: Jiang Wei is standing guard outside, keeping watch for the Chancellor. Seeing you, he lowers his voice. 'Master, the Chancellor coughed blood again tonight.'

label.en: Say goodnight and go.

text.zh: 你走的时候，姜维说：『先生，您也要保重。』
text.en: As you leave, Jiang Wei says, 'Master, take care of yourself too.'

label.zh: 问他：丞相要是不在了，你怎么办？
label.en: Ask him: if the Chancellor were gone, what would you do?

text.zh: 姜维很久没说话。最后他说：『接着打。丞相要的，我替他拿回来。』你从他的眼睛里，看见了你自己年轻的时候。
text.en: Jiang Wei says nothing for a long time. At last: 'Keep fighting. What the Chancellor wanted, I'll take back for him.' In his eyes you see yourself when you were young.

label.en: Ask about his mother.

text.zh: 姜维笑了：『她还在冀县。先生那时候替她说过话，我一直记着。』
text.en: Jiang Wei smiles. 'She's still in Ji. You spoke for her back then, Master. I've never forgotten.'

text.zh: 姜维低下头：『她来信说，叫我别回去了。』
text.en: Jiang Wei lowers his head. 'She wrote that I shouldn't come back.'

label.zh: 把你这些年记下的东西，说给他听。
label.en: Tell him what you've written down over the years.

text.zh: 你们说到天亮。姜维说：『先生，伯约有两个老师了。』
text.en: You talk until dawn. Jiang Wei says, 'Master, I have two teachers now.'

text.zh: 姜维说：『我母亲来信，问起那位替她说过话的先生。』
text.en: Jiang Wei says, 'My mother wrote. She asked after the gentleman who spoke up for her.'

text.zh: 丞相在帐中设了七星灯，主灯一盏。他说：七日之内主灯不灭，可以再活十二年。他让姜维带四十九个人守在帐外。第六夜，主灯还亮着。外面忽然喊声大作：魏兵来了。
text.en: In his tent the Chancellor sets out seven lamps for the Northern Dipper, with one master lamp. If the master lamp burns seven days without going out, he says, he may live twelve more years. He sets Jiang Wei and forty-nine men to guard outside. On the sixth night the master lamp still burns. Then shouting outside: the Wei army is coming.

text.zh: 你在帐外。魏延提着刀，急急忙忙地往帐里闯，要报军情。
text.en: You're outside the tent. Wei Yan, blade in hand, is rushing for the entrance to report.

label.zh: 拦住魏延：『军情我来报。你别进去。』
label.en: Stop Wei Yan. 'I'll make the report. Don't go in.'

text.zh: 魏延愣了一下，站住了。你掀开帘子，轻轻走进去。主灯还亮着。你刚要开口，一阵风从帐缝里钻进来——主灯灭了。丞相弃剑而叹：『死生有命，不可得而禳也！』他看着你：『不怪你。也不怪他。』
text.en: Wei Yan pulls up short. You lift the flap and step softly inside. The master lamp still burns. You open your mouth to speak, and a gust slips in through a gap in the tent—the master lamp goes out. The Chancellor lets fall his sword and sighs: life and death are fated; they cannot be prayed away. He looks at you. 'It isn't your fault. Nor his.'

label.en: There's no time to stop him.

text.zh: 魏延脚步急，竟将主灯扑灭。姜维拔剑要杀魏延，丞相拦住了：『此吾命当绝，非文长之过也。』他弃剑而叹：『死生有命，不可得而禳也！』
text.en: In his haste Wei Yan knocks the master lamp out. Jiang Wei draws his sword to kill him; the Chancellor stops him—it's his fate that has run out, not Wenchang's fault. He lets fall the sword and sighs: life and death are fated; they cannot be prayed away.

label.zh: 走进帐里，跪在丞相身边，替他看着灯。
label.en: Go into the tent and kneel beside the Chancellor, watching the lamp for him.

text.zh: 魏延闯进来的时候，你伸手去护那盏灯，还是慢了一步。丞相拉住你的手：『子衡兄，算了。』
text.en: When Wei Yan bursts in, you reach out to shield the lamp and are a moment too slow. The Chancellor takes your hand. 'Ziheng. Let it be.'

quote.zh: 延脚步急，竟将主灯扑灭。……死生有命，不可得而禳也！
quote.en: In his haste Yan knocked out the master lamp. … "Life and death are fated; they cannot be prayed away!"

title.en: Autumn Wind on the Wuzhang Plains

text.zh: 丞相让人扶着，坐上小车，出营看了一圈。秋风吹得他发抖。他叹道：『再不能临阵讨贼矣！悠悠苍天，曷此其极！』回到帐里，他把姜维叫到床前，把一生写下的兵书交给他：『吾兵法皆授与姜维，他自能继吾之志，为国家出力。』
text.en: With help, the Chancellor is lifted into a small carriage and taken round the camp once. The autumn wind sets him shivering. He sighs: never again to face the enemy in battle; O distant Heaven, where is the end of this? Back in his tent he calls Jiang Wei to the bed and gives him the books of war he has written all his life: all his art of war he passes to Jiang Wei, who will carry on his purpose and serve the realm.

text.zh: 然后他转过头来找你。
text.en: Then he turns his head to look for you.

label.en: Sit at the bedside.

text.zh: 丞相把那把白羽扇放进你手里：『白帝城那天，先帝把我们两个人的手放在一起。如今亮先走一步。伯约年轻，陛下也年轻……子衡兄，替亮看着。』你握着扇子，说不出话。那天是建兴十二年秋八月二十三日，丞相寿五十四岁。
text.en: The Chancellor puts the white feather fan into your hand. 'That day at Baidi the late emperor laid our two hands together. Now I go first. Boyue is young, and so is His Majesty… Ziheng—watch over them for me.' You hold the fan and can't speak. It is the twenty-third day of the eighth month, autumn, in the twelfth year of Jianxing. The Chancellor was fifty-four.

label.en: Sit at the bedside.

text.zh: 丞相拉着你的手：『子衡兄，这些年，辛苦了。』他闭上眼睛，再没有睁开。那天是建兴十二年秋八月二十三日，丞相寿五十四岁。
text.en: The Chancellor takes your hand. 'Ziheng, all these years—thank you.' He closes his eyes and never opens them again. It is the twenty-third day of the eighth month, autumn, in the twelfth year of Jianxing. The Chancellor was fifty-four.

label.zh: 趁丞相还清醒，劝他：魏延和杨仪，给魏延留一条路。
label.en: While he's still clear, urge him: Wei Yan and Yang Yi—leave Wei Yan a way through.

text.zh: 丞相想了很久，让人拿笔来，写了一封信，封好交给你：『等亮走了，文长要是闹，你把这个给他看。』那天夜里，丞相走了，寿五十四岁。
text.en: The Chancellor thinks a long time, then calls for a brush, writes a letter, seals it and gives it to you. 'When I'm gone, if Wenchang makes trouble, show him this.' That night the Chancellor dies, aged fifty-four.

quote.zh: 再不能临阵讨贼矣！悠悠苍天，曷此其极！……吾兵法皆授与姜维，他自能继吾之志，为国家出力。
quote.en: "Never again shall I face the rebels in battle! O distant Heaven, where is the end?" … "All my art of war I pass to Jiang Wei; he will carry on my purpose and serve the realm."

text.zh: 丞相说：『空城那天，你站在亮身边。亮的手在抖，你看见了。』
text.en: The Chancellor says, 'At the empty city you stood beside me. My hands were shaking. You saw.'

text.zh: 丞相说：『出师表里那几个名字，是你让亮写的。陛下用得上。』
text.en: The Chancellor says, 'Those names in the Memorial—you had me write them. His Majesty will need them.'

text.zh: 丞相笑了一下：『司马仲达问亮吃得多少。你怎么答的？』
text.en: The Chancellor smiles faintly. 'Sima Zhongda asked how much I eat. What did you tell him?'

text.zh: 丞相说：『你的孩子，该会叫人了吧。』
text.en: The Chancellor says, 'Your child must be talking by now.'

q.zh: 丞相走后的那天夜里，姜维跪在灵前，问你：『先生，丞相走了。伯约以后，该听谁的？』
q.en: On the night after the Chancellor dies, Jiang Wei kneels before the coffin and asks you, 'Master, the Chancellor is gone. Whom should I listen to now?'

text.zh: 姜维握住你的手：『先生不嫌伯约烦就好。』
text.en: Jiang Wei grips your hand. 'As long as you don't tire of me, Master.'

answers.match: 我|问我|来找我|ask me|come to me|me

text.zh: 姜维抬起头，看了你很久：『伯约记住了。』
text.en: Jiang Wei raises his head and looks at you a long time. 'I'll remember.'

answers.match: 自己|你自己|你的心|yourself|your own|your heart

means.en: says listen to His Majesty and the court

text.zh: 姜维沉默了：『是。』
text.en: Jiang Wei is silent. 'Yes.'

answers.match: 陛下|朝廷|天子|蒋琬|费祎|his majesty|the court|emperor

text.zh: 姜维没有再问，只是跪着。
text.en: Jiang Wei doesn't ask again. He just stays kneeling.

text.zh: 护送灵柩回成都的路上，你收到温芷的信：孩子会写自己的名字了。
text.en: On the road escorting the coffin back to Chengdu, a letter reaches you from Wen Zhi: the child can write its own name now.

text.zh: 护送灵柩回成都的路上，你收到温芷的信，只有一行：『回来吧。』
text.en: On the road escorting the coffin back to Chengdu, a letter reaches you from Wen Zhi. One line: 'Come home.'

label.en: Once back in Chengdu, resign and go home.

text.zh: 陛下没准，只给了你三个月的假。三个月里，你每天都在院子里。
text.en: His Majesty won't allow it, but gives you three months' leave. For three months you're in your yard every day.

label.zh: 回信：丞相的担子，我还得替他挑一阵。
label.en: Write back: I still have to carry the Chancellor's load for a while.

text.zh: 她回信说：『我知道。』
text.en: She writes back: 'I know.'

text.zh: 丞相已经很久没有问过你了。姜维私下说：『先生，丞相心里有事。』
text.en: It's been a long time since the Chancellor asked your opinion. Jiang Wei says privately, 'Master, something's on the Chancellor's mind.'

label.en: Go to the Chancellor and talk it through.

text.zh: 你们谈了一夜。天亮时，丞相说：『是亮想多了。』
text.en: You talk all night. At dawn the Chancellor says, 'I've been overthinking.'

hint.zh: 需要姜维的信任在「可托」以上，才有人替你说一句话
hint.en: Needs Jiang Wei's trust at Reliable or above for someone to put in a word

label.en: Wait. Do the work in front of you.

text.zh: 你的位子挪到了后排。
text.en: Your seat moves to the back row.

label.en: Take your leave.

text.zh: 丞相没有留你。
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't ask you to stay.

text.zh: 魏营里都在传：诸葛亮身边有个老先生，什么都知道。司马懿派人来打听你的名字。
text.en: In the Wei camp they're saying Zhuge Liang has an old man beside him who knows everything. Sima Yi has sent men to learn your name.

label.en: Hold your tongue from now on.

text.zh: 人们慢慢忘了。
text.en: People slowly forget.

label.en: Leave, so the Chancellor isn't tainted by you.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了营。
text.en: You leave the camp one rainy night.

text.zh: 你说过的那些话，有人抄了下来，送到了丞相案头。
text.en: Someone has copied down things you've said and put them on the Chancellor's desk.

label.en: Own it: you spoke out of turn.

text.zh: 丞相没有罚你：『子衡兄，管住嘴。』
text.en: The Chancellor doesn't punish you. 'Ziheng—mind your tongue.'

label.en: Argue: every word was true.

text.zh: 『有些真话，要挑时候说。』
text.en: 'Some truths need the right moment.'

text.zh: 魏延的刀已经出鞘了一半：『你再说一遍！』
text.en: Wei Yan's blade is half out of its sheath. 'Say that again!'

label.en: Bow and apologize.

text.zh: 魏延哼了一声，把刀推了回去。
text.en: Wei Yan snorts and slams the blade home.

label.zh: 不退：『你拔刀，丞相就护不住你了。』
label.en: Don't back down: 'Draw that, and the Chancellor can't protect you anymore.'

text.zh: 魏延盯着你看了很久，把刀收了回去：『先生说得对。』
text.en: Wei Yan stares at you a long time, then sheathes the blade. 'You're right, Master.'

text.zh: 你没有北上。五丈原的消息，是从集市上听来的。
text.en: You never went north. You heard about Wuzhang in the market.

text.zh: 你在一个雨夜出了营。魏营里少了一个打听的名字。
text.en: You left the camp one rainy night. The Wei camp had one less name to ask about.

text.zh: 你离开了。丞相走的那天，你在路上。
text.en: You left. The day the Chancellor died, you were on the road.

text.zh: 你护着丞相的灵柩，回到了成都。
text.en: You escorted the Chancellor's coffin home to Chengdu.

text.zh: 丞相把白羽扇放进了你手里：替亮看着。
text.en: The Chancellor put the white feather fan in your hand: watch over them for me.

text.zh: 五丈原那一夜，你拦住了魏延。灯还是灭了。丞相说，不怪你。
text.en: That night at Wuzhang you stopped Wei Yan. The lamp went out all the same. The Chancellor said it wasn't your fault.

text.zh: 空城那天，你在城楼上给丞相添香。他的手在抖，只有你看见了。
text.en: On the day of the empty city you tended the incense on the wall. His hands were shaking, and only you saw.

text.zh: 建兴十二年秋，丞相病逝于五丈原，寿五十四岁。蜀中人谚曰：死诸葛能走生仲达。
text.en: In the autumn of Jianxing 12 the Chancellor died on the Wuzhang Plains, aged fifty-four. In Shu they said: a dead Zhuge put a living Zhongda to flight.

text.zh: 马谡没有死。他被削为庶人，在汉中教孩子读兵书，每一课都从“当道扎营”讲起。
text.en: Ma Su didn't die. Stripped to a commoner, he teaches children the books of war in Hanzhong, and every lesson starts with 'camp on the road.'

text.zh: 街亭败了。可你和王平守住的那个路口，带回来了一半的人。
text.en: Jieting was lost. But the road you and Wang Ping held brought half the men home.

text.zh: 你劝过丞相别派马谡。丞相后来说，是他不听。
text.en: You urged the Chancellor not to send Ma Su. He said afterward it was he who wouldn't listen.

text.zh: 你和温芷的孩子，会写自己的名字了。将来的路，要他自己走。
text.en: Your child with Wen Zhi can write their own name now. The road ahead is theirs to walk.

text.zh: 你收的那个学生，把你说的每一句话都记在本子上。将来的路，要他自己走。
text.en: The student you took on writes down every word you say. The road ahead is his to walk.

text.zh: 姜维说：伯约有两个老师。
text.en: Jiang Wei says he has two teachers.

text.zh: 你身边，没有接你担子的人。
text.en: There is no one beside you to take up your load.

text.zh: 你怀里揣着丞相写给魏延的一封信。还没到拆的时候。
text.en: Inside your robe is a letter the Chancellor wrote to Wei Yan. It isn't time to open it yet.

text.zh: 魏延说：全营只有先生懂他。
text.en: Wei Yan says that in the whole camp, only the Master understands him.

text.zh: 魏延和杨仪的仇，丞相一走，就要爆出来了。
text.en: The feud between Wei Yan and Yang Yi will burst open the moment the Chancellor is gone.

text.zh: 桃园结义的三个人，最后一个，是在你手边走的。
text.en: Of the three who swore brotherhood in the peach garden, the last one died with your hand in his.

text.zh: 赵云把那杆枪留给了姜维。
text.en: Zhao Yun left his spear to Jiang Wei.

text.zh: 司马懿记住了你的名字。
text.en: Sima Yi remembered your name.

text.zh: 魏营里传说，诸葛亮身边有个老先生，什么都知道。
text.en: In the Wei camp they said Zhuge Liang had an old man beside him who knew everything.

text.zh: 人说子衡重义。
text.en: People say Ziheng keeps faith.

text.zh: 史书里没有你的传，只有几处『或曰』。
text.en: The histories give you no biography—just a few lines beginning 'some say.'

text.zh: 说书人讲到北伐，有好几处讲不顺——那几处，都是你。
text.en: When storytellers reach the northern campaigns, several places never quite fit. Those places are you.

text.zh: 丞相死了。蜀中的灯，暗了一半。
text.en: The Chancellor is dead. Half the lamps in Shu have gone dark.

garden.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。许都后园，青梅枝从左上探入，远处城墙，右侧小亭中二人对坐煮酒，雷雨将至。图层：雷雨（闪电、雨丝）。
garden.en: Chinese ink wash with light color, wide banner. A walled garden in Xuchang: green-plum branches from the upper left, distant city wall, two men seated drinking in a small pavilion on the right, storm gathering. Layer: storm (lightning, rain).

lamp.zh: 夜，窗格内一灯如豆，一人跪坐读书，窗外竹影。图层：案上一道红色血诏。
lamp.en: Night. Through a lattice window a single lamp, a seated man reading, bamboo shadows outside. Layer: a red silk edict on the desk.

herbs.zh: 药圃，圆形月洞门，竹匾晒药，一名医女。图层：同行男子；春日落花；粉色花瓣（恋爱时刻）。
herbs.en: Herb garden with a round moon gate, bamboo drying trays, a woman physician. Layers: a man beside her; spring blossoms; pink petals (romance moment).

road.zh: 平原大路，行军队列与红旗，远处许都城墙。图层：远处尘土中的追骑。
road.en: A plain with a marching column and red banners, Xuchang's walls in the distance. Layer: pursuing riders in a dust cloud.

letter.zh: 夜，烛光书案，信笺、毛笔、砚台。图层：药包；朱印；窗外江面火光。
letter.en: Night desk by candlelight: letter, brush, inkstone. Layers: medicine packet; red seal; river glow through a window.

hill.zh: 土山被围，山顶一将与两位女眷，山下敌营红旗，一骑来劝降。图层：一骑从山后小路突围。
hill.en: A surrounded earthen hill: a general and two ladies on top, enemy tents with red flags below, a lone rider approaching to parley. Layer: a rider escaping down the back path.

hall.zh: 厅堂内景，梁柱，门外天光。图层：梁上悬印、贴封条的箱笼；一匹赤红骏马。
hall.en: Hall interior, beams and pillars, daylight through the door. Layers: an official seal hanging from a beam and sealed chests; a red warhorse.

camp.zh: 北方营寨，群山，蓝红旗帜林立。
camp.en: A northern army camp among mountains, forests of blue and red banners.

mirror.zh: 竹林溪畔，隐士抚琴，二客远立。
mirror.en: Bamboo grove by a stream, a recluse playing the zither, two visitors standing at a distance.

snow.zh: 雪中茅庐，篱笆，门外数人立雪等候。图层：第四人（徐庶）。
snow.en: A thatched cottage in snow with a fence, several men waiting outside. Layer: a fourth man (Xu Shu).

bridge.zh: 长坂桥，一将横矛立马桥上，桥东树林，百姓奔逃。图层：林中尘土（疑兵）；白袍骑将救人。
bridge.en: Changban bridge: a general with a spear on horseback on the bridge, woods to the east, fleeing civilians. Layers: dust in the woods (feint); a white-robed rider rescuing.

slope.zh: 山坡上曹操与旌旗，坡下枪阵，一白袍将怀抱婴儿突围。图层：阵边缺口中逃出的车辆。
slope.en: Cao Cao and banners on a hilltop, spear ranks below, a white-robed general breaking through with an infant. Layer: carts escaping through a gap.

fog.zh: 大雾江面，远岸营火。图层：插满箭的草船。
fog.en: Fog on the river, distant campfires. Layer: straw boats bristling with arrows.

fire.zh: 赤壁夜江，铁索连舟。图层：火攻与红天；火船；后营空/后营起火；提灯小舟（接人）；下游未连锁的船。
fire.en: Night river at Red Cliffs, ships chained together. Layers: fire and red sky; fire ships; rear camp empty or burning; a small boat with a lantern (rescue); unchained ships downstream.

huarong.zh: 华容道，两侧峭壁，泥泞小路，残兵队列，一将立马拦路。图层：背药箱的女子在队尾。
huarong.en: Huarong road between cliffs, a muddy path, a column of defeated soldiers, a general blocking the way on horseback. Layer: a woman with a medicine chest at the rear.

campfire.zh: 夜营篝火，帐篷剪影，二人对坐火边，火星飞起。图层：城楼（古城）；横在膝上的刀。
campfire.en: A night camp: a fire with sparks, tent silhouettes, two men seated by the fire. Layers: a city wall (Gucheng); a blade across the knees.

riverbank.zh: 战后夜江，水面漂着焦木，远处余火，江边一名女子洗药杵。图层：身旁一名男子。
riverbank.en: The river at night after battle: charred timbers drifting, distant embers, a woman washing a pestle at the water's edge. Layer: a man beside her.

ending.zh: 尾声：晨江远山，红日。图层：两人同舟；江边茅屋炊烟；城郭；独立江岸；梅枝；远帆。
ending.en: Epilogue: river and mountains at dawn, red sun. Layers: two people in a boat; a cottage with smoke; city walls; a lone figure on the shore; plum branch; distant sail.

citywall.zh: 水墨淡彩，宽幅。城墙与城门，城上旗帜。图层：攻城的长梯与枪林；刘字绿旗或东吴红旗；城门洞开；城下人群；黄昏。
citywall.en: Ink and wash, wide. A city wall and gate with banners. Layers: siege ladders and spears; Liu's green banners or Wu's red; open gate; crowd below; dusk.

temple.zh: 山寺，松树，亭台，主客数人。图层：廊下暗藏的刀斧手；被劈开的石头。
temple.en: Hillside temple, pines, pavilions, a few figures. Layers: axemen hidden in the corridor; a split rock.

bigriver.zh: 大江上一艘大船，船上女子与侍从。图层：小船上的武将；怀中孩子；横江拦截的船队与绿旗；东吴的红旗船。
bigriver.en: A large ship on the river, a woman and attendants aboard. Layers: a general on a small boat; a child; a blockade of boats with green banners; Wu's red-bannered ships.

mourning.zh: 夜，灵堂，白幡，灵位与烛火，一人跪拜。图层：两侧吊客；角落一个相貌古怪的人。
mourning.en: Night, a mourning hall, white banners, spirit tablet and candles, one figure kneeling. Layers: mourners on both sides; an odd-looking man in the corner.

ravine.zh: 竹林夹道的山间小路，一骑白马。图层：箭雨；倒地的随从；勒马回头。
ravine.en: A narrow hill path between bamboo, a rider on a white horse. Layers: a hail of arrows; a fallen companion; the rider turning back.

liubei.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，四十岁左右的汉室宗亲，面如冠玉，两耳垂肩，短须，小冠，青灰色交领长袍。表情：平静/温和/冷淡/忧伤/吃惊。
liubei.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: an imperial kinsman around forty, fair face, very long earlobes, short beard, small crown, grey-green crossed-collar robe. Expressions: neutral / warm / cold / sad / surprised.

guanyu.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，面如重枣，丹凤眼，卧蚕眉，长髯过胸，绿头巾，绿袍。表情同上。
guanyu.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: face the deep red of a jujube, phoenix eyes, thick 'silkworm' brows, a beard past the chest, green headscarf and green robe. Same expressions.

caocao.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，丞相，细眼，长须，高冠，深红黑色官袍。表情同上。
caocao.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: the Chancellor, narrow eyes, long thin beard, tall official hat, dark red-black robe. Same expressions.

zhuge.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，二十七岁，纶巾，白色鹤氅，手持羽扇，神情从容。表情同上。
zhuge.en: Ink-wash bust portrait: twenty-seven, silk scholar's cap, white crane-feather cloak, feather fan, composed. Same expressions.

wenzhi.zh: 水墨淡彩半身像，原创人物：成年女医者，高髻，金簪，一朵梅花，浅蓝灰衣裙。表情同上，另加害羞。
wenzhi.en: Ink-wash bust portrait, original character: an adult woman physician, high bun, gold hairpin, a plum blossom, pale blue-grey dress. Same expressions plus shy.

zhouyu.zh: 东吴大都督，三十出头，面容俊秀，戴小冠，红色袍服；神情自负。表情：平静、微笑、冷淡、哀伤、吃惊、羞赧。
zhouyu.en: Grand Commander of Wu, early thirties, handsome, small cap, red robes, proud bearing. Moods: neutral, warm, cold, sad, surprised, shy.

lusu.zh: 东吴重臣，中年，短须，忠厚，赭色袍服。
lusu.en: Senior minister of Wu, middle-aged, short beard, honest face, ochre robes.

zhaoyun.zh: 身长八尺，浓眉大眼，阔面重颐（第7回）；银白盔甲，盔顶白缨。
zhaoyun.en: Eight feet tall, thick brows, large eyes, broad face and full jaw (ch. 7); silver-white armour, white plume.

sunfuren.zh: 孙权之妹，成年女子，发髻插金簪红花，红色衣裳，神情刚烈。
sunfuren.en: Sun Quan's sister, an adult woman, hair in a bun with a gold pin and red flowers, red clothes, fierce expression.

pangtong.zh: 浓眉掀鼻，黑面短髯，形容古怪（第57回）；褐色头巾。
pangtong.en: Thick brows, upturned nose, dark face, short beard, odd-looking (ch. 57); brown head scarf.

zhangsong.zh: 额镢头尖，鼻偃齿露，身短不满五尺（第60回）；尖顶小帽。
zhangsong.en: Pointed head, flat nose, protruding teeth, under five feet tall (ch. 60); small pointed cap.

fazheng.zh: 四十岁上下的谋士，面容清瘦，目光锐利，留短须，黑色纶巾，深青色袍服；神情冷静，似笑非笑。
fazheng.en: A strategist around forty, lean face, sharp eyes, short beard, black silk cap, dark teal robes; calm, a half smile.

huangzhong.zh: 年近七十的老将，白发白须，精神矍铄，身材魁梧，金色铠甲，背负大弓，手持大刀；笑容豪爽。
huangzhong.en: A general nearly seventy, white hair and beard, vigorous and broad-shouldered, golden armour, a great bow on his back and a broadsword; a hearty grin.

jiangwei.zh: 二十七岁上下的少年将军，相貌端正，眼神清亮，不留须，银蓝色盔甲罩青灰袍，文武兼备的书卷气。
jiangwei.en: A young general of about 27, handsome and earnest, clear bright eyes, clean-shaven, silver-blue helmet and armour over a blue-grey robe; a scholar who also fights.

simayi.zh: 五十岁上下，长脸，眼深而细，似回头张望，细长须，黑色高冠，深青色魏国朝服；隐忍、谨慎、难以看透。
simayi.en: Around fifty, long narrow face, deep-set watchful eyes, thin long beard, tall black hat, dark navy Wei robes; patient, cautious, unreadable.

weiyan.zh: 身长九尺，面如重枣，目若朗星，短黑须（不是长须），浓眉，钢盔、暗红铠甲；骄傲、勇猛、坐不住。要和关羽明显不同。
weiyan.en: Tall, face red as a ripe date, eyes bright as stars, short black beard (not long), thick brows, steel helmet, dark red armour; proud, fierce, restless. Clearly different from Guan Yu.

c7.en: The last campaign: camped on the Wuzhang Plains

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，你做到了。她没有说什么，只是把你的手握得很紧。
kept_text.en: You kept your word to Wen Zhi. She says nothing—only holds your hand very tightly.

broken_text.zh: 你答应过温芷的话，被你自己拿去换了军报。她再提起这句话时，语气平得像在念药方。
broken_text.en: The promise you made Wen Zhi, you traded for military intelligence. When she mentions it again, her voice is as flat as a prescription.

kept_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。一卷走完，你还在他身边。
kept_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. At the end of the volume, you're still at his side.

broken_text.zh: 你对刘备说过不离不弃。后来古城的消息传来，说他听说你留在了曹营，只说了一句：『人各有志。』
broken_text.en: You told Liu Bei you'd never leave him. Word reaches you that when he heard you'd stayed with Cao, he said only: 'Every man chooses his own road.'

kept_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，你守住了。在他那里，这比什么都重。
kept_text.en: You kept the word you gave Guan Yu. To him, nothing weighs more.

broken_text.zh: 你对关羽许过的话，没有守住。他再也不跟你喝酒了。
broken_text.en: You broke the word you gave Guan Yu. He never drinks with you again.

kept_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠。至少到这一卷为止，你做到了。
kept_text.en: You told Cao Cao you'd serve him faithfully. For this volume at least, you did.

broken_text.zh: 你对曹操说过要尽忠，却在长坂坡放走了刘备的家眷。他不知道。你知道。
broken_text.en: You swore loyalty to Cao Cao, then let Liu Bei's people go at Changban. He doesn't know. You do.

text.zh: 魏延的手已经按在了刀柄上。
text.en: Wei Yan's hand is already on his hilt.

rash.zh: 到 6：有人会把你的话报上去
rash.en: At 6: someone reports what you've said

desc.zh: 白帝城受托，南中七擒。丞相说：白帝城那天，先帝把你的手和亮的手放在一起。
desc.en: Entrusted at Baidi, through the seven captures in the south. The Chancellor says: that day the late emperor laid your hand with mine.

desc.zh: 你和温芷成了亲。院子里种了药，也种了一棵梅。
desc.en: You and Wen Zhi are married. The yard has herbs in it, and a plum tree.

desc.zh: 那一夜你守在张飞帐外。如今他老了，还在成都。
desc.en: That night you kept watch outside Zhang Fei's tent. He's old now, still in Chengdu.

desc.zh: 先帝说马谡言过其实。你把这句话告诉了丞相。
desc.en: The late emperor said Ma Su's words outran his worth. You told the Chancellor.

desc.zh: 南人说，丞相身边有个人，山里的事他都知道。
desc.en: The southerners say the Chancellor has a man who knows everything in the hills.

desc.zh: 你早早就离开了。南中的事，你是从远处听说的。
desc.en: You left early. You heard about the south from far away.
